launches.title: Amplitude AI Feedback — listen to users at scale
launches.tagline: Turn support tickets, call transcripts, and reviews into actionable product insights.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Stop guessing what users want. Amplitude AI Feedback helps you turn feedback into clear product direction.\
\
Try it for free at [amplitude.com](http://amplitude.com).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x_nPbObb_Vo&t=1s 

**The Problem**\
Teams are drowning in user feedback: Slack threads, app reviews, community posts, support tickets, survey data. You know the insights are in there somewhere, but manually parsing all that takes too long.

Lots of AI tools summarize text, but they don’t actually _understand_ product needs or surface actionable insights.

**The Solution**\
Amplitude AI Feedback gives you clarity:

* Automatically groups feedback into feature requests, pain points, and bugs
* Shows how often each topic comes up, with links back to original comments for context
* Connects insights directly to product analytics so you can see what really moves the needle
* Lets you ask your own questions and write PRDs with AI, based on all the data

AI Feedback was first built by Kraftful (acq by Amplitude), where the team quickly scaled it to 50,000+ product builders. Joining forces four months ago allowed our teams to connect what users say to what users do in the product for the ultimate product insights. \
\
Give it a try on [amplitude.com](http://amplitude.com)!

launches.title: OneSignal is powering Autonomous Lifecycle Marketing for B2C Companies
launches.tagline: Announcing our Autonomous Lifecycle Marketing Vision and new products including OneSignal AI, Brand Center, MCP, and Slack Agent
launches.body:
Hi Launch YC,

I'm the founder and CEO of OneSignal. Today, we're announcing our new AI vision, and I'm excited to share it with the Launch YC community.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r7ccDbGVJ5U>

**The problem**

OneSignal first went through YC as a mobile gaming company called Hiptic Games.

After pivoting away from mobile games, we used our experience to uncover an opportunity to truly "Make something people want," and began working toward a mission to Democratize Customer Engagement for B2C companies.

For years, most B2C marketing automation products have had lengthy implementation processes, dated interfaces, and a learning curve steep enough that many teams hire a full-time expert. Many of them were also built in a world where email was the dominant channel, and have zero or weak support campaigns that span across Email, Mobile Push, SMS/RCS, and other channels.

In contrast, we made OneSignal incredibly easy to use from the start: customers can get going for free with an intuitive product experience, a powerful suite of tools for omni-channel messaging, and the performance to support some of the largest brands in the world. Today, OneSignal sends billions of daily messages for hundreds of thousands of active apps.

But no matter how easy and powerful we made the product, marketers still needed to bring a lot of their own time and expertise to get the best results from their campaigns.

**The solution**

Today, I'm excited to announce our vision and the products that will make lifecycle marketing autonomous. Our mission is still to Democratize Customer Engagement, but with AI we can achieve it in ways that were never possible before. This AI vision enables us to empower under-resourced marketing teams with the time and expertise that has seemed always out of reach.

We've broken this mission into phases, which we think of as an autonomy ladder. Most marketers don't want to hand the keys to an autonomous system on day one, so we'll roll out features that build the systems and trust needed at each step.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/09a43a18-3ca8-4268-bd70-ab1798220546)

**Level 0 — Manual.** The dashboard. A marketer drives every click, and the team scales by hiring. This is where the entire category has lived.

**Level 1 — Assistance.** AI drafts copy, suggests audiences, and explains your analytics in plain language. You review and ship. This is live today.

**Level 2 — Expert Assist.** AI becomes proactive. It recommends campaigns to fill lifecycle gaps, flags mistakes, and checks your work. Your input is still required.

**Level 3 — Agentic Autopilot.** You delegate bounded work, and AI does it within the scope and rules you've defined. You approve work in batches.

**Level 4 — Full Operator.** You set the goals and the guardrails. AI plans, sends, tests, and improves campaigns against them, reaching out only when it needs you.

**What we're launching today**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/da0aff66-9335-4ac3-87bf-d61aaa95b014)

**OneSignal AI** — An in-product agent that can do everything a person can: generate message copy, design emails, analyze message performance, and recommend next steps to maximize user engagement. Best of all, it can create and analyze complex multi-step Journeys, saving hours of work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/f96522b2-51f9-404c-83fe-5b8bcbf4618a)

**Brand Kit** — Define your audience, voice and tone, industry, and visual assets on a centralized configuration page or pull them automatically from your website. Set guardrails for language to avoid. OneSignal AI uses your Brand Kit when generating copy, email designs, and in-app messages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/b4c791bc-66cd-4849-afbf-d6921338d492)

**OneSignal MCP** — Brings OneSignal's capabilities to the AI tools and agents you already use. The MCP is available now on the ChatGPT and Cursor marketplaces, coming soon to the Claude marketplace, and available through Smithery for any other AI client. Together, the MCP and the OneSignal API make it possible to use the platform in a fully headless way.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/16f8ec08-92f4-4612-b342-555017d5082b)

Soon, we'll also release a OneSignal Slack Agent, bringing the capabilities of OneSignal AI and the OneSignal MCP to where your team already spends its time. And we'll be rolling out an API to create, edit, and analyze Journeys, so your team can set up complex campaigns without ever logging into the OneSignal dashboard.

**Try it today**

All of these features are available on OneSignal's free plan. Small companies can send unlimited push notifications and up to 10,000 emails per month for free. Paid plans start at $19/mo plus affordable usage-based pricing. Installing OneSignal is as simple as copying a prompt into Claude Code. You can get started at https://onesignal.com

PlayAbly turns ignored touchpoints into mini-games that capture attention, drive action, and generate real-time first-party data—across eCommerce, B2B funnels, restaurants, and in-store retail. As attention spans shrink to six seconds, brands can't afford lifeless popups, forms, or landing pages. We replace them with gamified conversion layers—quizzes, swipe games, stackers—that perform like performance marketing.

At Unity, our founding team helped personalize gameplay and ads for over 2 billion users. Now, we're bringing that behavioral insight to brand engagement, building a no-code platform where anyone can launch PlayAbly experiences in minutes. Think: instead of a "Spin to Win," a match-3 game that sells your product, segments your audience, and gets 4× the opt-ins.

Why now? Retargeting costs are up. Email/SMS open rates are down. And today’s customers are conditioned by the dopamine loops of TikTok and mobile games. Generic funnels can’t compete—but interactive ones can.

PlayAbly is already driving results:

Classkick (B2B): 5× ROI, 3× higher email open rates

Skout Snacks (DTC): 7× ROI, 20% higher AOV, 4× opt-in rates

89% of previously lost sessions re-engaged through PlayAbly games

We monetize on a usage + performance model, enabling fast adoption and deep long-term value. We're building a new category: AI-powered gamification that converts attention into intent, on any surface where customers meet brands.

https://www.playably.ai
one_liner: We build games to help brands engage, convert, and retain customers

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: We started PlayAbly because we saw the problem from the inside.John and Angelo met while working at **Unity Technologies**, where we helped scale ads and gameplay personalization to billions of users across mobile games. We saw firsthand how **interactive experiences and behavioral data could drive attention, trust, and action**—all in under six seconds.But outside of games? That magic was missing. We watched friends in **eCommerce and B2B** spend heavily on ads, only to lose users to static websites, generic forms, and boring popups. Every marketing funnel looked the same—and underperformed.We asked: _What if we brought the mechanics of play to commerce, sales, and brand storytelling?_So we built PlayAbly: a gamified engagement layer that turns any passive touchpoint—landing page, QR code, email popup—into a fun, branded, data-rich experience. We didn’t just want to optimize clickthroughs; we wanted to **make customer interaction feel like something people actually wanted to do**.We chose to be founders because we couldn’t unsee the gap—and we knew we had the technical and behavioral playbook to fill it.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: **The Problem:**\Brands spend billions to drive traffic—but lose most of it in the first 6 seconds. Today’s customer experience is passive, generic, and forgettable. Popups are ignored. Forms are abandoned. Retargeting is expensive. And brands don’t know _why_ visitors bounce or _who_ they really are.**Why it matters:**\Whether it’s eCommerce, B2B, or in-store, **the attention funnel is broken**. Customers are trained by TikTok and games to expect interactivity and dopamine—yet most brand experiences still feel like static brochures. This leads to poor conversion rates, bloated CAC, weak data, and missed revenue. In a post-cookie world, brands need ways to engage and personalize without relying on surveillance or guesswork.**Why we’re working on it:**\At Unity, we personalized gameplay for 2B+ users. We saw how **interactivity + real-time data** could drive deep engagement and monetization in milliseconds. But when we looked outside of gaming—at Shopify sites, SaaS landing pages, QR flows in restaurants—it was clear: brands had _no tools_ to make those touchpoints dynamic, fun, or behavior-aware.We built PlayAbly to fix that. Because **capturing attention shouldn’t feel like a chore**—and because we believe brand experiences should be just as interactive and addictive as the games people play every day.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is to replace passive brand touchpoints with **a new standard for interactive, personalized engagement—powered by play.**If we truly succeed, **every ad, popup, QR code, and landing page will become a game—one that captures attention, reveals intent, and feels native to the brand.** Just like TikTok rewired content discovery, PlayAbly will rewire how people experience commerce, lead funnels, and brand storytelling.But that’s just the start. As our experiences spread across eCommerce, B2B, retail, and hospitality, we’re building the foundation for a **first-party engagement network**—a permission-based, gamified layer where brands can acquire, qualify, and retain customers through interactive journeys, not invasive ads.Instead of renting attention from Meta or Google, brands will use PlayAbly to **own the moment of interaction**, gather usable zero-party data, and re-market through personalized games and offers that people actually want to play. And instead of interruptive ads, our long-term vision is to launch a **PlayAbly Ad Network**, where top-performing game experiences can be distributed across partner sites, apps, and displays—with performance economics and behavioral data baked in from the start.Imagine:* A DTC brand acquiring new customers not through banner ads, but through a mini-game embedded in a partner brand’s checkout page.* A restaurant upselling via a playful quiz shown on smart menus or receipts.* A SaaS company qualifying leads with an interactive diagnostic game built into someone else's onboarding flow.**We’re building the infrastructure for the gamified internet—where every touchpoint is playable, personal, and performant.**That’s the world we want to live in. And that’s the world PlayAbly will help create.

launches.title: PlayAbly - the confluence of shopping and entertainment
launches.tagline: Introducing PlayAbly – Your customer engagement sucks. Try this instead.
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋 We’re John and Angelo — former Unity Technologies ads, analytics, and data leads — and we’re building **PlayAbly**: the AI-powered gamification layer that turns website traffic into high-intent, high-converting journeys. The confluence of shopping and entertainment.  

🧠 At Unity, we personalized gameplay for 2B+ users across thousands of titles. Now we’re bringing that same behavioral insight to B2B brands and ecommerce — where most sites still feel too generic, not an engaging experience

🎯 We saw it firsthand: brands burning cash on top-of-funnel, only to leak it through lifeless landing pages, collection pages, and generic lead forms. So we built PlayAbly — a conversion layer that feels like fun but performs like performance marketing.

🌍 Used by both B2B and DTC:

* **Classkick (B2B tool for teachers)**: to qualify and convert education leads via smart quiz games.
* **Skout (DTC Kid’s Snacks)**: to increase AOV and conversion rates with fun product discovery

🧨 TL;DR: Replace "Spin to Win" with a game your online customer _actually_ wants to play.

---

### **❌ The Problem**

Brands spend on Meta, TikTok, SEO — but don’t _retain_ attention once shoppers land. Today’s customers ignore pop-ups, abandon forms, and bounce from even the best-looking sites. Why?

Because passive web experiences can’t compete with the dopamine drip of social and mobile gaming. And standard segmentation flows — quizzes, email captures — are too slow, too boring, or too static to convert attention into action.

Retargeting is expensive, email/SMS open rates are tanking, and most stores don’t know who their customers really are.

🕳️ Most marketing funnels are:

* Bland → no interaction, no retention
* Blind → poor data on why visitors bounce
* Bloated → costly retargeting with low ROAS

### **✅ Our Solution**

**PlayAbly** creates opportunities for engagement —online, in-store, and everywhere in between.

We help brands turn passive moments into active engagement—whether that’s on a website, at a retail display, with a QR code at a restaurant, or in a B2B lead funnel. From quizzes to mini-games, our interactive layers boost attention, capture data, and drive action—bridging consumption and entertainment to make every brand moment more memorable and more effective.

**Playable funnels**: Games that _feel native to your brand_ and drive:

* 📈 Higher engagement
* 💬 Useable first-party data
* 💸 Measurable revenue lift - conversions up to 3x, 2x more email/SMS opt-ins than the leading popup, recover 89% of lost engagement

🎯 How it works:

* Choose from our library of high-performing game templates (e.g. match-3, swipe, scratch, stack)
* Customize it to your brand’s look, products, and tone
* Integrate via Shopify, Klaviyo, Hubspot, or embed directly
* Launch in minutes — no dev required
* OR - if you’re looking for a more custom game, let us know what you’re looking for

🧠 Behind the scenes: AI + behavioral data personalize the game, questions, and post-game flow based on real-time signals.

---

### **🚀 Why It Works**

Our games don’t just entertain — they segment, educate, and convert:

* **DTC: Skout Results: 7X ROI, 4X Email Opt-ins, 20% Higher AOV** 

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91780&key=user_uploads/330167/3f68a566-f189-489f-b637-08595f1985f3)

* **B2B: Classkick Results: 5X ROI, 3X Email Open Rates** 

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91780&key=user_uploads/330167/570759ec-4110-4bd6-bc39-ad002047c964)


Retention’s better too: PlayAbly games collect data that actually gets used — building better lists, sequences, and personalization downstream.

---

### **💡 Why We Built It**

At Unity, we pioneered user-level personalization through gameplay — optimizing ads and UX with real-time behavioral signals. We saw firsthand how play builds trust, surfaces intent, and creates emotional stickiness.

We asked: what if B2B sales and ecommerce wasn’t just functional, but _fun_?

So we built PlayAbly:

* To help brands personalize authentically — not creepily
* To make every site visit feel like a VIP concierge interaction
* To let brands build relationships, not just retargeting funnels

We believe AI should act like the best in-store rep: observant, empathetic, memorable — not a template engine.

---

### **🕹️ Want to Try?**

We’re working with DTC and B2B brands who want:

* Better conversion/retention without more ad spend
* Higher-quality customer data, captured playfully
* Personalization built around _actual_ shopper behavior

🕹️ Try a PlayAbly game:

* [Replacements Matching Game](https://playably-game-uploads.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/uploads/1745836341267/game/index.html)
* [Playfield Dog Days of Winter Advent Calendar](https://advent-calendar.ourplayfield.com/)
* [PlayAbly Spinner Hunt](https://playably-game-uploads.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/uploads/1746022904086/game/index.html)
* [Harmony 783](https://playably-game-uploads.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/uploads/1747054636675/game/index.html)

\
[Book a Demo ](https://calendly.com/john-baotris/playably-demo-kf?)

Whether you're selling skincare, classrooms, or courseware — let’s make it fun, data-rich, and wildly effective.

launches.title: mailX by mailwarm - Instant deliverability diagnostics for AI agents & humans.
launches.tagline: mailX tells you why emails go to spam and how to fix it, via web, API, and MCP.
launches.body:
Hey YC

I’m [Amine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bengeekly/), CTO of Mailwarm (YC S20) and today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).\
[Thami](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thami-benjelloun/) is the CEO, [Othman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/othmankatim/) is our Head of deliverability and we are ready to help you with all your email deliverability problems.

We’ve been working on email deliverability since 2020. Mailwarm started as an email warmup tool and became [#1 Product of the Day](https://www.producthunt.com/products/mailwarm) on Product Hunt. Since then, we’ve helped thousands of teams improve sender reputation and inbox placement.

Today, we’re building a broader email deliverability ecosystem:

* **Mailwarm** helps teams build sender reputation through real inbox interactions.
* **mailX** helps humans and AI agents diagnose deliverability issues.
* **MailAdept** helps companies fix and monitor deliverability continuously with AI agents and human experts.

Today we’re launching [mailX](https://themailx.com).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/836ee2bb-f82d-4b97-9c90-c77c6d0d62f0)

---

## TL;DR

**mailX tells you why your emails go to spam and how to fix it.**\
You can run a deliverability check from the web, use it through a JSON API, or plug it directly into AI agents through MCP.

No signup.\
No API key.\
Free to use.

Try it here: [**https://themailx.com**](https://themailx.com)\
MCP endpoint: [**https://themailx.com/mcp**](https://themailx.com/mcp)

---

You can also book a call with one of our email deliverability expert [HERE](https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx).

## 🚨 The Problem

Email deliverability is technical, your marketing team can’t handle it.

Email is still one of the most important growth channels for startups.

Founders use it for cold outreach.\
Sales teams use it for outbound.\
Marketing teams use it for campaigns.\
Products use it for onboarding, activation, and transactional emails.

But when emails start going to spam, most teams don’t really know why.

They check random tools.\
They look at raw DNS records.\
They ask ChatGPT.\
They change things blindly.\
They wait and hope inbox placement improves.

The problem is not only that deliverability is technical.

The real problem is that most tools show data, but don’t explain what matters or what to fix.

And now, with AI agents sending emails, monitoring systems, and managing workflows, this problem gets bigger.

Agents need access to live deliverability tools too.

---

## 💡Our Solution

**mailX is a free deliverability diagnostic platform for humans and AI agents.**

With mailX, you can analyze a domain in seconds and get a clear report showing:

* What is working
* What is broken
* Why it matters
* What to fix next

The web app gives founders, marketers, sales teams, and developers a simple way to understand why emails may go to spam.

The API and MCP server make the same tools available to AI agents and developer workflows.

So instead of copying DNS records into different tools, your agent can directly check email authentication, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and deliverability signals.

---

## ⏳How it works

1. Enter a domain on [**themailx.com**](http://themailx.com)
2. mailX runs a live deliverability audit
3. You get clear issues, explanations, and fixes
4. Developers can use the JSON API
5. AI agents can use the MCP endpoint directly

The best part is that you can lets you AI Agent fix your deliverability or directly integrate it to your Claude or ChatGPT.

Here’s a quick demo of mailX:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YWmV7-wthQI>

In the demo, we show:

* Running a domain audit
* Getting clear fixes
* Using the MCP/API layer for AI agents and developers

We currently support checks and tools for email authentication, DNS records, blacklist status, mail server configuration, and record generation.

---

## Why now?

Email deliverability used to be something only email experts cared about.

Today, every startup relying on outbound, lifecycle emails, AI SDRs, or automated email workflows needs to understand it.

At the same time, AI agents are becoming part of the stack.

But agents need tools.\
They need live data.\
They need safe, structured ways to diagnose and act.

That’s why we made mailX available through:

* Web app
* JSON API
* MCP server
* Agent skill
* LLM discovery endpoints

Our belief is simple:

**Email deliverability should be understandable for humans and usable by AI agents.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101509&key=user_uploads/422675/ffc97aad-6864-4525-a89d-0aa1f7890289)

---

## Backstory

In 2019, we failed a startup after 2 years of work.

After that, we decided to test ideas much faster: one launch per week.

Every launch used the same growth channel: email.

Cold emails.\
Partnership emails.\
Launch emails.\
Follow-ups.

That’s when we understood something obvious: If your emails don’t land in the inbox, nothing else matters.

That led us to build Mailwarm in 2020.

After years helping thousands of teams improve deliverability, we kept seeing the same pattern: People don’t know why they land in spam.\
And even when they see the data, they don’t know what to fix.

mailX is our answer to that.

---

---

## 🙏 Our Ask

We’d love your feedback from the YC community.

If you are doing cold email, email marketing, transactional email, or building AI agents that send or monitor emails, try mailX and tell us what is missing.

Also, if you are building an AI agent or workflow where email deliverability matters, we’d love to talk.

Try mailX: [**https://themailx.com**](https://themailx.com)\
Book a call through MailAdept if you want help choosing the right setup: [https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx](https://calendly.com/mailwarmsessions/mailx?month=2026-05)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80666&key=user_uploads/517243/20c1ff56-623e-45a3-b1fc-d1350d5d4d11)

**TLDR:** [Rethoric](https://www.rethoric.com/) is a data-driven thought leadership content creation as a service that amplifies the personal brands of busy founders with personalized content on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Newsletters to build credibility, attract funding, and acquire customers on autopilot.

### **📖 The Context:**

Founder-led marketing is one of the most effective and high-converting acquisition strategies for startups.

**That is why many founders are investing time and resources in building their personal brand**

* **Garry Tan** knows the importance of personal branding, so much so that he went in and created his own YouTube channel. [**https://www.youtube.com/c/garrytan**](https://www.youtube.com/c/garrytan)
* **Ankur Nagpal**, founder of Teachable (acquired by Hotmart), uses his personal brand as the main acquisition strategy for his current startup, Carry. [**https://twitter.com/ankurnagpal**](https://twitter.com/ankurnagpal)
* **Rahul Vohra**, founder of Superhuman, leverages X to talk to customers and maintain his authority in the email space. [**https://twitter.com/rahulvohra**](https://twitter.com/rahulvohra)
* **Dharmesh Shah**, co-founder and CTO of Hubspot, posts almost daily on LinkedIn and X and has achieved a massive Thought Leadership authority in the tech space. [**https://twitter.com/dharmesh**](https://twitter.com/dharmesh)

And the list goes on…

### **😩 The Problem:**

* Founders are extremely busy and don’t have the time or energy to create content daily because they are swamped working on their startups.
* Founders don’t know how to implement an effective organic content strategy
* Traditional marketing methods like branding or paid ads don’t work how they used to and end up in unsustainable CACs

### **🚀 The solution**

[**Rethoric**](https://rethoric.com/) is not an AI tool that writes content for you. **World-class human writers and editors create all the content** with your own voice based on your insights, lessons, experiences, and stories, which we extract on interview calls.

**How it works:**

* Step 1: **Join an Interview Call Twice a Month,** during which we extract your expertise into optimized social-media-ready content.
* Step 2: **Approve Twice a Month** - We send you 2-week content batches for review with unlimited revisions.
* Step 3: **Engage Online** - We coach you to reply and start engaging in conversations in your comments.

### **🤩 Benefits of Investing in Your Personal Brand as a Founder**

**Save Time**

Just a 45-minute call and a quick 15-minute content review every two weeks, and 5-10 minutes per day to reply and engage in the comments. We handle the rest, letting your personal brand flourish while you focus on what you do best.

**Fundraise Easier**

Position yourself as an industry authority. Our content showcases your thought leadership, attracting investors eager to support visionaries with proven insights and innovation track record.

**Attract Top-Level Hires**

When your personal brand shines, so does your appeal to high-caliber talent. They'll be lining up to work with you, drawn by the promise of being part of a visionary-led future.

**Build Credibility and Status**

As your stories and insights circulate, your status as an industry leader solidifies. Building a brand isn't just about being seen; it's about being recognized as the go-to expert in your field.

**Reduce Your Acquisition Costs**

launches.title: 📈Positional — A modern platform for content marketing & SEO
launches.tagline: Start, grow, and scale your inbound marketing and SEO strategy with a toolset optimized for results — not vanity metrics.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** We make starting, growing, and scaling your inbound marketing and SEO strategy easy. With Positional, our goal is to connect the workflow from end to end, from keyword research to analytics, and the actions that users take that ultimately drive revenue for a business. We are building the toolset we’ve always wanted. **Get started with **[**Positional**](https://www.positional.com/)**!**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/QF-DahK75XYQ8xgTgYaqDd904aT5bYQ77DL2-hsdNfQHSV7zioFI-8ULa6h4H4ti6UNxeKtejnElqq7tKMvirI5Y5_2TUBsSfyUOBPikH048lAFBxFxPCkgqOFBAXS8PfFw8I-a-vIWfg-HvR4EczX8)

Hi everyone, we’re [Nate](https://www.linkedin.com/in/natematherson/) and [Matt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-lenhard-0babb037/), co-founders of Positional.

We’ve been working on Positional for about 13 months. Our company, however, was actually in Y Combinator’s S21 batch. In short, we spent two years building something _that people didn’t want_. We decided to make a hard pivot, and that ultimately led us to Positional.

## [🌲](https://emojipedia.org/evergreen-tree) We are back to our roots. 

About ten years ago, we fell in love with inbound marketing, particularly content marketing and SEO. Since then, we’ve built and scaled content channels in some of the world’s most competitive industries (e.g., consumer finance, and developer tools).

We’ve wanted to start Positional since at least 2019. As content marketers and SEOs, we found ourselves constantly jumping between 6-7 separate tools throughout the day. We had one toolset for keyword research, another for content optimization, yet another for internal linking, and then an entirely different set of tools for measuring the success of our channel and analytics.

**With Positional, our goal is to bring the entire workflow together. Positional takes you from start to finish, from ideation to optimization and analytics.** 

## [💪](https://emojipedia.org/flexed-biceps) One platform to do the job.

Today, Positional has 11 thoughtfully built features. Of course, we have tools for keyword research and tracking. But we also have a number of really unique experiences and workflows for internal linking, content optimization, content analytics, and mapping buyer journeys.

### [🔎](https://emojipedia.org/magnifying-glass-tilted-right) Ideation

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/wKWlHN4QsHDSc7i2e6zMreZIBxr6t6sY3zpsiJ194ZiittqTC23FtizQb3UDjpQFN_62ZYOQ-KSNByQpWRSDh6zVe8L_famgs7uyXXsYhPQkxoYDPCIXxGUdnDlaZN5zjGcSLeJQcVQfdoJZMf5fQHU)

_Keyword Tracking within Positional._

* **Keyword Research** — An intuitive keyword research toolset, providing advanced insights into how your audience searches, engages, and converts.
* **Keyword Tracking** — Monitoring keyword performance has never been easier.
* **Competitor Research** — Quickly identify the keywords your competitors are ranking for that you aren’t.
* **Keyword Clustering** — Never manually check the SERPs again. Keyword clustering is done for you. SERP-based.
* **Editorial Calendar** — A simple editorial calendar that works alongside your core SEO toolset.

###  🙌 Optimization

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/h6wnsHzX4AsQqITCoUN88N1_Dun_-dSLg_c2Hjt7XoggRNQ0H_EABz9n9Npb5HhCydMnh2TS4gOktbOj-xwVSy73OB959e2AWienrATsFLTi7zWcsLsRXIKypqrRepJnbafhW-b9zXMz17fgysgkiTs)

_Optimize within Positional. Highlighting Unanswered Questions._

* **Optimize** — A data-driven approach to creating fantastic content that actually ranks.
* **Internals** — Internal linking has never been this easy.
* **AutoDetect** — Check the originality of content before it goes live. **To be upfront:** Our toolset is certainly not 100% accurate, although we are constantly improving. False positives and false negatives will regularly occur.

### [📈](https://emojipedia.org/chart-increasing) Analytics

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/7kQjFkMmOn1VS7Nnk2M2ek6Tr0je3g_qVnbdCX9bKmOn39jMlnj4928ezn8geKeWF5FeYNjfcCiSqG8dg1e9rdu8y1KpoFd4PD8HAHLwe8_v6vtivopXIXGsIiNv1XEs7l_M8wT60W8aAfc2EZFeBV8)

_Content Analytics within Positional. Highlighting Readmap._

* **Content Analytics** — Know exactly which pages to improve and where to make those improvements. Kinda like a heatmap but more granular for in-article insights.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/UDhG3cNIWCFyO8DHsTEAnih3KbfKrpSrvgNfrDn3c5n2ldGkktkiVWOTJV_TeYreYUr2T1Vfwqg7vBXz2iZ5LUGqZk9Lk48LhS00_CfskG5DhAB4VBWF6xDNH1IIHnPR2dZmk2i7_VaMsfxWain3M9o)

_Buyer Journeys within Positional._

* **Buyer Journeys** — Analyze user flows from entry points to conversion pages. Use data to optimize content within your most common user paths.

### [🚨](https://emojipedia.org/police-car-light) Socials

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/E07-g96asIuclXlLrw0MP9aZYwfTxYDcdzm2l2ohVGYy4k4eTkJE7VFOpczg-Hfl6mCRKskbfS0GI5-DSuY1FAOzc9AmwDW927A3gSO8uPcxA9WntO4UTXNcY_sSWUMd91B8oIU04o7mXBovDimhdAo)

_Social Listening within Positional._ 

* **Social Listening** — Social listening across your favorite platforms (ex Reddit, LinkedIn, Twitter, Hacker News). The first toolset within our social platform!

## 👋 Getting Started with Positional

We’d love for you to give us a try! Positional was launched publicly today, and there is a trial. 

Sign up at [Positional.com](http://positional.com)!

Alternatively, we’d love to hear from you. We’d be happy to show you around our toolset if you’d like a quick demo. You can book a call with Nate using this [Calendly link](https://calendly.com/positional)!

By the way, if you’ve made it this far, know that we’ve got a pretty awesome [SEO blog](https://www.positional.com/blog) and [weekly SEO podcast](https://www.positional.com/podcast), too!

launches.body:
Hi everyone! We are [Beau](https://github.com/hartshorne) and [Dirkjan](https://github.com/djc), and we're here to present [Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc), an AI tool that helps you **find proven influencers who already love your product.**

Dirkjan is a [rustls](https://github.com/rustls/rustls) maintainer and built a fast open-source [vector database](https://github.com/instant-labs/instant-distance) in Rust before anyone knew they needed one. As an engineer on Facebook's growth and mobile teams, [Beau](https://www.github.com/hartshorne) helped rebuild Facebook twice, once on the [web](https://techcrunch.com/2009/09/10/breaking-facebook-lite-launches-in-the-u-s/) and again on [iOS](https://techcrunch.com/2012/08/23/facebook-for-ios-faster/).

[**Book a call**](https://calendly.com/strobe/beau) with Beau to learn how growth teams are working with influencers now.

### Problem

Founders and growth teams tell us that while influencer marketing has a high ROI, it’s very hard to **find and evaluate content partners at scale.**

1. Finding partners who really understand and care about their products is hard.
2. Teams do not want to work with creators who post controversial content or are already working with their competitors. But it’s nearly impossible to review thousands of posts by scrolling.

### Our solution

[Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) connects first-party social APIs with modern LLMs so you can quickly find and evaluate influencers in your community. We’re launching with Instagram and will soon roll out integrations with LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms.

1. [Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) finds influencers in your social communities who already love your products. You can also import your existing customers to find influencers who already use your products.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80532&key=user_uploads/10064/7c4f48ef-9042-4b52-a9d3-5362a373b7e9)

2. [Strobe’s](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) fine-tuned LLMs instantly review thousands of posts with dozens of GPUs to identify key performance metrics, topics, controversial topics, brand partnerships, and unlabeled sponsored content.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80532&key=user_uploads/10064/800331c9-de29-4c76-8f94-48fa13aecf9d)


### Our customers

[Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) helps growth and marketing teams at software companies find great content partners at scale. Here are two examples:

1. A large public B2C software company with \~1M followers uses [Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) to segment and analyze their audiences, including customers, to find content partners for influencer marketing.
2. A growth-stage B2B software company with \~75k followers uses [Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) for competitive research and to screen out creators who share content that does not represent their brand values.

### Our ask

1. [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/strobe/beau) with Beau to see how [Strobe](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc) can help your team
2. If you have an Instagram professional account, sign up for a free trial at [Strobe.app](https://strobe.app/?utm_source=launch-yc&utm_medium=yc-platform&utm_campaign=yc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80532&key=user_uploads/10064/944f654d-acf1-4ad1-a134-771a2237e1e5)

### Thank you!

launches.title: Reforged Labs - Generate and optimize video ad campaigns
launches.tagline: Generate and optimize video ad campaigns at superhuman speed
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78942&key=user_uploads/844410/a67b3219-3d42-44ad-b0fc-77040bc0eb90)

**TL;DR:** [Reforged Labs](https://reforgedlabs.com/) is automating the full marketing cycle for mobile game studios with GenAI. Our text-to-ad creation and campaign performance solutions will slash time spent on ad creatives and help game developers get more mileage out of their game ad budgets.

😤 **THE PROBLEM**:

Marketing games is expensive and challenging. Mobile game studios spend >50% of their budgets on marketing - more than on development itself - to acquire and retain players. Today, your marketing workflow likely consists of this:

* Design up to thousands of image, video, and playable ad units per campaign - for multiple campaigns across multiple ad networks
* Analyze how each ad unit performs - then try your best to figure out which aspects of your ads made them hit or miss (because your reporting tools won’t be giving you that data)
* Revise your ads and design new ones based on your best guess on what makes your players tick, without knowing whether your experimentation will pay off
* Manually replace old and low-performing ads with new ones, and repeat the process across all your ad channels

🤩 **THE SOLUTION**:

We make marketing campaigns substantially faster to run + deliver higher returns on your ad spend. Upload your game images and footage, enter simple text prompts for the ads you’d like to see, and we’ll extract the relevant visual assets and create your ads using a proprietary combination of LLMs, machine perception, and computer vision. Automatically resize finished creatives to fit multi-platform specs and export them as campaign-ready ad units.

Reduce your ad development time from days / weeks / months to minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78942&key=user_uploads/844410/179c886c-ad78-41b9-bc44-f9c4d354a183)

Once your campaign is up and running, our models analyze and identify which attributes likely made certain ads more effective. Our self-improving models will

🎨 Improve your existing ads by adjusting visual elements to include performance-lifting attributes

🌟 Create new & original ads based on re-scanning your uploaded assets

🚀 Automatically push new & improved ads to your x-channel campaigns and retire low-performers

Increase the ROI on your biggest expense with continuous, data-driven optimization.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78942&key=user_uploads/844410/03f5587d-e3e3-4796-88f5-5b8aa2871c30)

🎮 **OUR STORY**:

[**Oscar**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/oscarxingluo) and I ([**Robert**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/huynhrobert/)) met over two years ago as serial founders who shared a love for gaming (and countless hours of duo-queuing in League of Legends). We wanted to put our data science and GenAI/deep learning backgrounds to work on solving one of the biggest problems in a space we’re deeply passionate about - and that’s how Reforged Labs was founded six months ago. We’ve since formed a guild of ex-Googlers, ex-Rioters, ex-Microsofties, and a rolodex of indie and multinational clients, to join us on our journey to innovate game marketing!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78942&key=user_uploads/844410/d5a46d9b-d785-4a88-aea3-c26aa725589a)

🙏 OUR ASK:

Our waitlist is [**here**](https://reforgedlabs.com/) and our inbox is always open at [**founders@reforgedlabs.com**](mailto:robert@reforgedlabs.com)
* **Ideas and feedback!** We’re constantly looking to connect with people with expertise in gaming, martech, and AI. Hit us up through our [**Calendly**](https://calendly.com/reforged/meet-robert) to let us know what would make you want to use a product like Reforged, or just to chat!

**Meet with us in person at GDC March 18-22.** We’ll be around the corner of the Moscone Center and ready to mingle!

launches.title: Vessel: Easily integrate with your customer’s CRM
launches.tagline: Vessel allows developers to read and write to their customer’s CRM with one integration.
launches.body:
### ⁉️ Problem

For products that need access to their customer’s CRM, having a breadth of integrations has become table-stakes. However, it is difficult to build CRM integrations in-house, because you need to:

* support different types of authentication
* understand the data model, APIs, and ever-changing specs of each CRM platform
* handle platform limitations like API quotas and limited webhooks support
* transform data from your customer’s CRM for use in your product

Companies are spending a lot of engineering resources building and maintaining CRM integrations in-house. For instance, we spoke to a company that built a HubSpot integration and had to turn it off because they didn’t have the resources to handle HubSpot’s API limits.

### 💡 Solution

Vessel is the universal API for CRMs, making it easy for developers to build applications that integrate with their customer’s CRM.

* A unified interface to read and write across 8 objects: Accounts, Leads, Contacts, Deals, Events, Notes, Tasks, [Users](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/603bd0ce2abb1-get-all-users)
* [Webhooks](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/e1m6clym4s5ya-webhooks) to keep your data fresh without polling even if the end platform does not offer webhooks on certain objects.
* A drop-in UI to securely connect your customer’s CRM to your product
* Avoidance of rate limits for platforms you integrate with
* Improved developer experience with strongly associated objects. You can easily identify all of the associated objects (e.g. going from leads -> accounts, accounts -> leads)

### ⚡ Get started

If you’re looking to integrate CRMs into your product, book some time [here](https://calendly.com/vesselapi/vessel-demo) or send us an email with your use case at [founders@vessel.land](mailto:founders@vessel.land)! Learn more at <https://vessel.land>.

launches.title: CustomerOS – Uncover hidden pipeline that actually converts
launches.tagline: The only B2B platform that tells you who to target, how to win, and what actually converts
launches.body:
Most top prospects never fill out forms, making them invisible until it’s too late. 

CustomerOS uses a team of AI-agents to identify and score leads based on their behavior, alerting sales with the right messaging at the right moment. It automatically builds your ideal customer profile, tracks buyer intent in real-time, and provides actionable insights for SDRs and decision makers.

https://youtu.be/Cru5GSrRfHQ

### The Team

We’re Matt & Jonty, the team that helped build Voxbone to a $519M exit and we’re now building the GTM platform we wish we’d had. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Seedcamp, Crane, and Cocoa.

### The Problem

**92% of your best leads don't fill out forms.**

They do deep research, and show real buying intent, but we never know who they are until it’s too late. By the time we realize they were interested, they’ve already signed with someone else who actually saw them coming.

Meanwhile your SDR drowns in unqualified “MQLs” that will never close.

CustomerOS solves this problem.

### Our Solution

CustomerOS surfaces high-fit leads that are actually evaluating your product in real-time. It scores buying stage and intent from their behavior and alerts sales with content and messaging to share at exactly the right moment to drive deals forward.

With CustomerOS you have a squadron of purpose-built AI agents, engineered to 

1. Outsmart your competition
2. Accelerate your pipeline
3. Turn every touchpoint into revenue firepower
4. Help SDRs focus on the leads that actually convert

### Here’s How it Works

### Your Ideal Customer Profile

CustomerOS automatically generates your ICP based on your website, content, and existing customers.  Then we score every lead  based on how well they fit your ICP.

Only high-fit leads make it into your pipeline so you don’t waste time on prospects who are never going to convert.  Everything on your screen is a qualified lead we actually WANT to close.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/0508be1e-076a-4b1a-87b6-073b8d7ed078)

### See Who's Ready to Buy

With our easy-to-setup web tracker, you can follow each lead's intent in real time. This allows you to know where they are in their journey and who’s ready to buy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/861fca57-630d-4eab-ab5b-f22ae5cbe953)

### Competitive Intelligence for SDRs

Each lead comes with tailored battle cards showing how big the opportunity can be, who else they’re likely evaluating, and what we need to do to win.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/bf890845-4aeb-4f3e-b770-d5ad51ae7287)

### Insights for Decision Makers

We automatically pull together insights from your lead behaviour, content engagement, and ad spend, and turn them into strategic recommendations that show decision-makers exactly where to double down and what to cut.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94089&key=user_uploads/995798/51b3828a-21e3-43f1-a1d2-3e8993be5122)

### Our Ask

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Create your dream GTM motion at the speed of thought. Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence. Avina finds matching companies 24/7, enriches them with verified contacts, writes personalized sequences tied to the exact signal, and syncs leads wherever your team works. Signal to AI outbound, fully automated. Starting at $149/mo.

👋 Hey friends, we're Vivek and Mike (YC S22). We previously built and sold Bowtie to Mindbody, and now we're building Avina to fix outbound.

<https://youtu.be/rdUnYD9Z6Ac>

**The problem**

Generic outbound is dying, but doing smart outbound is still painfully hard.

The pitches that get replies are the ones that arrive right when something happening at the prospect's company makes your product feel relevant. The hard part has always been finding those moments at scale and acting on them fast.

**Our solution**

Avina finds the companies that actually need your product right now, qualifies them, and automatically engages them with personalized AI outreach. All synced with your existing sales stack.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/d34b49d3-f41b-4940-83da-11472e593ba8)

**How it works**

Describe your ideal buyer or buying trigger in a single sentence:

* _Selling usage-based billing?_ "PLG companies that just launched an API in the last 3 months"
* _Selling compliance automation?_ "Companies awarded a prime DoD contract in the last 30 days"
* _Selling cybersecurity?_ "Healthcare companies that experienced a data breach in the last 6 months"
* _Selling voice AI?_ "Mid-market home services companies with recent negative reviews mentioning 'long wait times' or 'understaffed'"

It works for first-party intent too. Website visitor de-anonymization is built in (RB2B, Vector, and more), so you can act on inbound signals like "prospects that visited our pricing page for more than 2 min.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99611&key=user_uploads/185378/601dc08e-720f-4466-9deb-433c0902d7df)

Avina takes it from there. Four agents handle the full pipeline:

1. **Signals Agent** monitors the web 24/7 for matching companies: press releases, job posts, LinkedIn posts, technographics, inbound site visitors, and more
2. **Qualification Agent** scores leads against your ICP, finds your target contact at the company, and enriches them with verified contact details.
3. **Outbound Agent** researches each company, writes personalized emails tied to the specific trigger, and sends via your existing sequencer (Instantly, HubSpot, Lemlist, Smartlead) so you keep your warmed domains
4. **Workflow Agent** syncs every lead to the rest of your stack: CRM lists, Slack, Clay, Zapier, and more

**Try it free!**

Start a 14-day free trial at [avina.io](http://avina.io).

Not sure what signals to start with? Our in-product **Signal Recommender** analyzes your website and suggests high-impact buying triggers, and we have a[ library of 250+ examples for inspiration](https://avina.io/signals-library).

Influencer marketing is no longer a nice-to-have - it's a core growth channel. But finding the right creators is still painfully manual.

The current process looks like this: you open a platform, set some filters (follower count, category, location), scroll through hundreds of profiles, and then manually watch their content to figure out if they're actually a good fit. Does their aesthetic match our brand? Have they worked with competitors? Do they tell stories in a way that resonates with our audience?

These are the questions that matter most, and none of them show up in metadata.

Traditional discovery tools search profiles. They can tell you a creator has 50K followers in the beauty category. But they can't tell you whether that creator films in a warm, cozy bedroom aesthetic or a bright studio setup. They can't tell you that a creator mentioned your competitor's product in a GRWM last Tuesday, without a hashtag or tag.

---

# **🛠 How Syncly Solves This**

Syncly Social analyzes what's actually happening inside the content – every frame, every word, every sound. Instead of filtering by metadata, you describe what you're looking for in natural language, and Syncly finds creators whose content matches.

* **Storytelling style** - conversational, educational, high-energy, or laid-back
* This means you can find creators that genuinely fit your brand's identity - not just creators who check the right demographic boxes. And because you never have to watch a single video yourself, it scales.

# **Challenges of Social listening platform 1.0**

**High volume of Noise data:** Legacy platforms rely on simple keyword queries to gather data. The problems are:

* **Time-consuming**: Takes up to a couple of months to setup, repetitively.
* **Less than 10% data is relevant:** For example, product names or sub-brands with generic or common imagery (like Discover and United) can lead to irrelevant content being collected.

**Lack of Granularity in Analysis:**

* Let’s say "picture quality" may be frequently mentioned for mobile brand. So what? To translate that into specific product or marketing insights, the insight should be more granular, but what you can get from legacy platform is the summary, at most, like “_People generally praise the picture quality on Samsung phones, particularly on their high-end models.”_

**One-Dimensional Sentiment Analysis:** Traditional sentiment analysis often fails to capture the full context, especially when posts contain mixed emotions.

* For example, a review that says, "It’s not as bright as {product name}" might seem negative, but since {product name} is a brand’s another product, it isn’t necessarily a critique of the brand as a whole. This inaccuracy complicates efforts to identify precise product improvements or refine marketing messages.

# **Why we need Social listening platform 2.0 - Syncly social**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87956&key=user_uploads/971454/daffa167-4b77-47ae-8b0a-edf4809e5be5)

* **⚡️ 90% Faster Setup:** Forget tedious keyword lists of what to include and exclude that often take up to a couple of months🤯. Syncly's AI automatically filters irrelevant chatter.
* **🎯 Hyper-Targeted Insights:** Brands went _beyond_ basic sentiment to identify specific product issues and opportunities.
* **😊 Nuanced Sentiment Analysis:** Syncly pinpointed _exactly_ which features customers loved (or hated) with aspect-based analysis.
* **🌎 Language Agnostic Brand Tracking:** Global consumer brands, like LG Electronics, could track brand mentions in different languages without needing to translate keywords.

# **Impact**

Insights that once took **months** now surface in just **days**, enabling your brand to refine products, optimize marketing, and stay ahead of competitors, fast.

# **Learn more use case**

If you’re interested in learning more use cases how Modern brands achieve competitive advantage through social listening, [schedule a demo](https://www.syncly.app/demo) with me.

Here’s how Syncly helps top B2C companies like:

and fast-growing YC companies like:

* **Speak**, **Ello**, **Navattic**, and many others.

It’s difficult to get visibility into the user sentiment trends and what can be done to elevate customer experience from a product perspective. Even when you get it, it’s not actionable. Why?

* **Product insight is not granular enough:** unable to pinpoint customers/customer groups at risk and understand the details of their issues on your product.

launches.title: Athina AI: The Ultimate Monitoring and Evaluation Platform for LLM Developers
launches.tagline: A suite of tools to supercharge LLM development and help you ship high-performing, reliable AI applications
launches.body:
### **TL;DR: Athina helps you monitor and evaluate your LLM powered app. Plug and play evals in production. 5 minute setup.**

—-

👋 Hey everyone! We’re thrilled to announce the launch of [Athina AI](https://docs.athina.ai/), a suite of tools for LLM developers to ship and develop AI products with confidence.

### What is Athina AI?

Athina AI is a **Monitoring & Evaluation platform** for LLM developers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77263&key=user_uploads/731066/30a27eb5-a787-46d2-8420-cb2c30da24e2)

Developers use Athina’s evaluation framework and production monitoring platform to improve the performance and reliability of AI applications through real-time monitoring, analytics, and automatic evaluations.

### 🔴 The Problem

* It is difficult to measure the quality of Generative AI responses.
* Eyeballing responses is tedious, leading to slow development cycles
* No easy way to detect unreliable or bad outputs (especially in production).
* Difficult to make changes to prompt or retrieval pipeline with confidence without introducing regressions.
* Poor visibility into all the steps in your LLM inference pipeline

LLM developers typically have to build and maintain lots of in-house infrastructure for monitoring and evaluation.

### 🟢 Our Solution: Athina AI

[Athina](https://docs.athina.ai) is a comprehensive suite of tools to supercharge your LLM development lifecycle and help you ship high-performing, reliable AI applications with confidence.

* **Quick Setup**: [Get started](https://docs.athina.ai/logging/log_via_api) in just 5 minutes! The entire integration is 1 simple POST request _(and we don’t interfere with your LLM calls)_
* **Comprehensive Monitoring Platform**: Full visibility into your LLM touchpoints. Search, sort, filter, compare, debug.
* **Prebuilt Evaluations**:
  * You can configure automatic evaluations in just a few clicks - use one of our preset evals or define a custom eval.
  * These evals will run against logged inferences automatically.
  * You can also use our [**open-source library**](http://github.com/athina-ai/athina-evals) to run evals and iterate rapidly during development.
* **Granular Analytics**:
  * Tracks usage metrics like response time, cost, token usage, feedback, and more.
  * Athina also track metrics from the evals, like Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Sufficiency, etc
  * You can segment these metrics by any property: customer ID, environment, model, prompt, etc.
  * For example, you could use Athina to see how **prompt/v4** is performing for customer ID **nike-usa** and how **gpt-4** performance compares to a **llama-finetune**.

**Who is this for?**

Athina is designed for developers building AI products.

If you’re in the prototyping or development stage, you can use Athina to get visibility and [rapidly test](https://docs.athina.ai/evals/develop_dashboard) the LLM generated responses.

![](https://docs.athina.ai/develop-ui-results.png)

If you have launched your AI in production, you can use Athina to monitor and evaluate your LLM in production.

### 🌟 Our Story

As a team of engineers and hackers, we spent a summer trying to build various LLM-powered applications for developers.

While working with LLMs, we found that the most challenging part was evaluating the Generative AI output and systematically improving model performance.

On speaking with other AI developers, we discovered a major gap in the tools that engineers need to effectively build production grade applications using LLMs, and set out to solve this problem.

### 🚀 Get Started

Athina AI is a comprehensive suite of tools to supercharge your LLM development lifecycle and help you ship high-performing, reliable AI applications with confidence.

Here’s how you can get started:

* 🌟 Sign up for a free account at [app.athina.ai](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/knowledge/Eq-launch-yc#compose-your-launch-yc-post)
* Log your inferences using [this guide](http://docs.athina.ai/logging/log_via_api).
* Try our [open source evals](http://github.com/athina-ai/athina-evals).
* [Schedule](https://cal.com/shiv-athina/30min) a call with us

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: After working on creator-related products for three years at Pinterest—and talking with dozens of creators about the challenges they faced—Varun and Leon began brainstorming different ways creators could better monetize the enormous value they delivered to their audiences and to brands. After testing a number of concepts, they became excited by the idea of building better discovery experiences to help brands find creators for their campaigns. A mutual friend connected them with Carina, who was independently building something similar. Andrew had also previously worked with Varun and Leon on discovery at Pinterest, and joined the team as well. Soon after, 1stCollab was born!

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: We’re focused on solving a two-sided marketplace problem, for brands and creators. For brands, their biggest pain point with influencer marketing is discovering and sourcing creators. Platforms that exist today not only cost >$30k each year, but have very limited discovery capabilities. For instance, [Grin.co](http://Grin.co), one of the top two influencer marketing platforms today, does not surface any Instagram influencers as part of their sourcing tools. We’re going to be the first influencer marketing platform that prioritizes discovery and create the best discovery experience for brands by growing a network of authenticated creators and surfacing those creators through industry leading discovery algorithms and experiences. For creators, 99% of creators don’t get brand deals today, because creators don’t have a way to actively apply to relevant campaigns. By creating an open platform that has a broad set of brands, we can help creators apply to campaigns by showcasing those brands and their campaigns to relevant creators. Creators know their audience and content the best, and through encouraging creator participation, we can facilitate better matchmaking between brands and creators than any platform out there.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: From working at social media companies, we know that users engage at much higher rates with sponsored creator content than organic ads. But the market for sponsored influencer content is being held back, because it’s hard to run influencer marketing campaigns and the tools out there today don’t make it much easier. 1stCollab will simplify and automate influencer marketing the same way that Facebook and Google transformed the digital ads market. If we’re successful, we’ll enable a new category of ad spend—helping more brands to leverage influencer marketing and shift more of their budgets towards it. That’s money that goes directly to creators, enabling orders of magnitude more people to make a living as full-time creators. We have the opportunity to make content creation a genuinely feasible career for many, many talented folks out there—and we’re excited to make it happen.

launches.tagline: Build a community of thousands of creators for your brand–instantly
launches.body:
**tl;dr**: 1stCollab is the fastest way to test, optimize, and scale your influencer program. Instantly source thousands of creators, and let our platform handle everything — outreach, negotiations, contracting, payments, and taxes — all while maximizing ROI.

**Product Demo:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0KI3LN-xqdM

**Ask**: Introduce [leon@1stcollab.com](mailto:leon@1stcollab.com) to companies interested in influencer marketing!

## The Problem

We’ve spoken with hundreds of startups running influencer programs, and nearly all hit the same roadblocks:

* **Low response rates.** They reach out to about 10-20 influencers and don’t get any responses. 
* **Time-consuming processes.** Even if some creators reply, sourcing, negotiating, contracting, and paying them quickly turns into a full-time job (or an agency retainer).
* **Scaling is hard.** Early success is exciting, but optimizing and expanding campaigns takes costly tools, headcount, and process.

## What 1stCollab does

1stCollab helps you test out and scale your influencer marketing program to hundreds of creators with an hour of setup work. We do this by automating the exact same influencer process that the world’s best marketing teams run. 

Here’s how it works:

**Step 1: Instantly source thousands of influencers**

Free to try out! We’ve indexed all of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube so you’ll quickly be able to find relevant creators using our search and recommendation tools.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/7c914441-b10e-4367-99c6-253a39f48bf6)

**Step 2: We take care of outreach, negotiations, contracting and payments.** 

We handle everything to bring the right creators on board at the right price. You’ll see the full negotiation history and campaign pipeline. Our pricing engine predicts ROI using real-time engagement signals and proprietary data from hundreds of thousands of deals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/05e49138-75eb-4fdc-b941-e24044207a7d)

**Step 3: (Optional) Review content**

Creators submit concepts and draft videos for your approval. All revisions stay organized in one place. Once you give the green light, we take care of payouts and collect performance data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/fc46b925-16b3-4ef8-82df-1380a85dec64)

\
**Step 4: Analyze your metrics**

As creators are going live, we’ll report out on real time engagement and link click metrics. We’ll cut things by ad groups as well so you can experiment with different briefs and creator populations to understand what works well. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/90bbd692-5064-454d-a9c4-a20748bd411e)

## Some of our campaigns

We’ve helped hundreds of startups start their influencer campaigns and scale up to **some of the largest campaigns on social media**. Some interesting case studies to check out include [Framer](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/framer), [Locket](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/locket), [Gamma](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/gamma) and [SnapCalorie](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/snapcalorie)!

## How to get started

Start [sourcing creators for free](https://brands.1stcollab.com/) or schedule [some time with Leon](https://calendar.app.google/Zd88eFtzJF3TKs3k6) so we can discuss campaign strategy and we can share with you best practices

Already running influencer campaigns? A/B test us against your current program — we’re confident we can improve your performance and efficiency!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/96f60d67-2c55-48e9-9d78-35dcdddb8e28)

launches.title: 1stCollab — Run an influencer marketing campaign in less than 30 minutes 🎉
launches.tagline: 1stCollab is an AI-powered influencer marketing platform that automates the process of running an influencer marketing campaign.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Influencer marketing is one of the most efficient ways to reach and acquire new customers, but it’s tedious to run campaigns. By leveraging machine learning and our prior campaign data, 1stCollab lets you run a campaign in under 30 minutes. Visit [1stcollab.com](http://1stcollab.com) to get started with your next influencer marketing campaign!

### **Why is influencer marketing hard?**

From our time working at large social media platforms, we know that influencer marketing consistently outperforms organic ads. Unfortunately, launching an influencer campaign is a manual and lengthy process. _Launching an influencer campaign takes weeks_, while launching Google ads takes just minutes. 

The first step of every influencer campaign is to find the right creators to work with—which often takes over 50 hours per campaign. Existing solutions cost tens of thousands of dollars and operate off inaccurate data. As a result, the majority of influencer marketers spend hours manually searching on YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram. From there, they have to manually calculate stats, vet a creator’s audience, evaluate past partnerships, and negotiate rates and contract terms, review creatives, report out campaign metrics, and finally submit payments. This whole process often takes 2+ weeks for a single campaign.

### **How does it work?**

1stCollab lets you launch an influencer marketing campaign in minutes—not weeks. All you have to do is find a single influencer who's relevant to your brand and target customers. Then:

1. Use our [influencer look-alike discovery tool](https://www.1stcollab.com/) to identify, vet, and save additional influencers you'd like to work with. We do what the best influencer marketers do: identify a single relevant creator, dig through that creator’s community, identify additional relevant creators, and repeat the process—but automatically.
2. Send us your list of saved influencers and tell us about your campaign goals and budget.
3. We'll take care of everything from there. All you have to do is approve the content that the influencers will post.

We support campaigns on all platforms. Our self-serve discovery tool currently supports YouTube, and we’re launching for Instagram and TikTok soon.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70145&key=user_uploads/1168808/a5397e58-9fda-4820-8ec8-945d2930f80d)

### **Our Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70145&key=user_uploads/1168808/214846e7-6c27-47c6-9213-4ecac24313be)

Our team has built some of the largest and most-used discovery and ML systems in the world, and has led industry-leading influencer marketing programs.

* [Leon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/leonqlin/) spent nine years at Pinterest, where he was most recently Head of Discovery Product. 
* [Varun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bansalvarunb/) was at Pinterest for five years, where he led product for both the Creator Engagement and Recommendations teams. 
* [Carina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carina-cater/) led influencer marketing at Whatnot, Robinhood, and Curology.
* [Andrew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zeyu-liu/) was the tech lead for the Recommendations and Search team at Coupang and the Recommendations team at Pinterest.
* [Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevinlau93/) was a Founding Engineer and tech lead for the Machine Learning team at Abnormal Security and earlier, an engineer on the Recommendations team at Pinterest.

### **Our Ask**

* **Want to give influencer marketing a try?** We'd love to help! We're the easiest and fastest way to do it. Our discovery tool is free to try and we’re happy to help you run the rest of your campaign.
* **Know someone doing influencer marketing?** We'd love to be connected. Even if our product isn't the right fit, we’d love to know how we can make their process faster and improve their performance.
* **No plans to run an influencer marketing campaign?** Feel free to use our discovery tool and explore creators you might want to work with in the future! We'd love to get feedback on the discovery experience.

If you have any questions, shoot us an email at [hello@1stcollab.com](mailto:hello@1stcollab.com)!

launches.body:
### _TL; DR,_

1. _Customers connect all data sources (CRM, ads, web, and product analytics…) to HockeyStack to create a source of truth for customer engagements. No engineering work required._
2. _HockeyStack shows which channels, campaigns, content, segments, etc. drive the most revenue and active customers._
3. _HockeyStack creates lists of high-intent accounts that customers can use to launch the most efficient sales & marketing campaigns._

We’re Arda, Buğra, and Emir. We came from Turkey & dropped out of our first semester of college in the US to build [HockeyStack](https://www.hockeystack.com/?utm_source=launchyc), because we realized that every single B2B enterprise has the same exact #1 problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/5a0ce469-00e7-416a-8af0-ba3a7b9f0718)

### Problem

Revenue-facing teams in B2B companies run all their operations on customer data, whether it is managing an advertising budget, launching integrated campaigns, closing deals, or retaining customers. But there is no central system of record for customer data that they can use to run their operations, so instead, they rely on tens of different data tools and spreadsheets.

The CRM was built for this purpose, but over 20 years it got outdated, and companies found themselves either having to find hacks to format their data to fit the CRM, or build a data warehouse from scratch.

### Solution

HockeyStack collects all data about customer interactions through a web analytics script, a set of integrations to revenue-related business systems (CRM, ads, marketing automation, email, etc.), and data partners.

Any non-technical person in a B2B company can use HockeyStack’s reporting interface to answer complex questions like:

* What marketing channel had the best unit economics this quarter?
* Which segment of companies do we have the highest account penetration in?
* What makes a customer buy our software faster?
* Who are the highest intent companies who have not yet booked a demo with us?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/d86c6313-72ee-42ce-9500-4875f29a8a3b)

They click into the numbers, and can see a list of accounts behind the report, all of which have their entire history of engagement with the company displayed alongside important firmographics.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73647&key=user_uploads/307556/25f109b6-83e0-44d3-bb45-3a5ae267d2de)

This information can be used to create and export lists of high-intent accounts based on different segmentations out to various marketing and sales platforms to start or accelerate the sales conversation.

### **🙏 Ask**

We’d love to be introduced to marketing and sales leaders at B2B enterprises or scale-ups!

### 🤲 **Give**

We’d be happy to help any B2B founder with advice in generating inbound pipeline.

You can reach me at [bugra@hockeystack.com](mailto:bugra@hockeystack.com) or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bgrgndzz/).

launches.body:
### 🏎️ TLDR

Kite helps software companies create stunning marketing videos in minutes. Take a screen recording of your product and turn it into a polished video–no experience required.\
\
👉 Try out Kite on Mac OS (alpha): [**https://kite.video**](https://kite.video?ref=launchyc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/6bca3709-f628-4c2b-a533-6fb825209d17)

👋 Hey there!

Derek and Todd from Kite here.

### 🥲 The Problem

Top companies know that the way they present themselves to the world matters. **Great storytelling amplifies great products**.

When Apple launches a product—or even the tiniest feature—they don’t just put out a press release or a Tweet. They put on something closer to a cinematic film premiere—using video to craft a story and make their audience truly appreciate their features, one by one.

Most of us aren’t Apple, but need to tell our story all the same. **Nearly every software company needs marketing videos**, not just once, but continuously.

Users prefer video to text and social algorithms boost it heavily.

The world is noisy. Every feature release is an opportunity to relaunch your product and tell your company’s story once again.

(Some companies we think crush it with frequent feature launch videos: Framer, Brex, and Vercel).

**The thing is, making great marketing videos is still _really_ hard.**

Derek has been pulling out his hair making startup marketing videos for over a decade, both for his own products and as a contractor.

Existing solutions are either **bland**, **tedious**, or **expensive**:

* **Simple screen captures** work well for internal communication but aren’t great for grabbing attention externally, and tend to all look the same. Attention spans are short, and a lot of software just…isn’t that engaging on its own.
* You can cobble together **powerful video tools** (After Effects, etc), but you’ll probably spend way longer than you’d like, end up with a janky result, and feel like you should have earned a film degree by the end.
* Or, you can **hire a video creator** (contractor, agency, or full-time). Tech companies spend a LOT on marketing video creation (We know, we’ve talked to your video people!).

### 🪁 The Solution

Our goal with Kite is to help any software company create studio-quality marketing videos—no studio required.

Here’s a quick Kite video we made for our Product Hunt launch this week:

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u2Gz6JI2KSk)

We start with **screen capturing** your product. It’s easy. If you can take a Loom, you can take a Kite.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/e83335c6-d414-483e-a806-fd7726d03239)

Then we turn it into a ridiculously professional video—semi-automatically.

* Show off your app on the screen of a **3D device model** (like a laptop).
* Kite **automatically moves the camera** to follow the action and highlight the features your cursor is interacting with.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/c491535d-1987-4417-a0aa-fca72a90b324)

* Add **animated text** (kinetic typography) with two clicks.
* Sync it all together to the beat of a music track from our **music library**
* Check out our tutorial video for more detail:

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1lhSIGDW98)

(**This entire video was made in Kite**, you can explore the full project file in the app).

### 🛣️ Roadmap

We want to make Kite more comprehensive and automatic with each update–abstracting away all the tedious parts of making great videos, and giving you all the cool stuff you see in big co-marketing videos for free, so can let your creativity run wild.

We've only been working on Kite for a few months, but there's a lot coming!

* **AI-assisted video creation**
  * **LLMs** – Chat with Kite like you’d chat with a video creator. Get help with everything from copy editing and storytelling to animations and fonts.
  * **Generative AI** – narrations, music, graphics, 3D objects
  * 3D object scans for physical product demos
* More **customization**–animations, text effects, music, 3D devices, backgrounds, cursors, etc
* **Mobile videos** & iPhone screen capture
* Designer **templates**

### 🔮 The future

* We’re starting with software videos because it’s an area we know well, but we’re not stopping there. We think the web is a more engaging place where everyone can create great videos and we're excited to help create the next generation of **AI-first video tools**.

### 👉 Try out Kite on Mac OS (alpha): [**https://kite.video**](https://kite.video?ref=launchyc)

You can use the entire product **for free**, just upgrade to remove watermarks.

Send us feedback, bug reports, and questions! [support@kite.video](mailto:support@kite.video)\
\
Derek & Todd (& Harvey 🐶)\
Kite\
🪁🪁🪁
