launches.title: ✨ 🫴 Hidden Hand: AI-powered client intake for law firms
launches.tagline: Faster intake, less labor, better advocacy.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, I’m Bennett from [Hidden Hand](https://hiddenhand.io).

**TLDR: Hidden Hand uses AI to reduce client intake time by 30%, allowing law firms to focus on providing better advocacy for all their clients.**

# 

# **The Problems**

There are \~450,000 law firms in the US, many of which are _boutique_ law firms that focus on one practice area, like personal injury or workers’ compensation.

* **Client Intake Bottleneck**: The key bottleneck is their client intake process - efficiently identifying suitable clients and onboarding them with contracts, insurance, documents, etc.
* **Importance of Empathy:** Lawyers are here to help people. Nobody wants a robot to represent them. Empathy and human connection are crucial to signing and keeping a client.
* **Antiquated Tech, Low-Risk Appetite:** Law firms are built on outdated technology, which translates to outdated workflows. Many are hesitant to change systems because of the importance of the human side of law.

# **AI + Human = Better Advocacy**

Hidden Hand provides a hybrid solution that combines the best parts of both automated intake and human-led intake to increase speed without sacrificing human connection.

* **Offload easy tasks to AI:** We build customized messaging chatbots and beautiful intake forms for tasks that don’t require human involvement. Don’t worry, we always give clients the ability to talk to a real human. _Less labor, more time for what matters._

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73645&key=user_uploads/396461/f19dc744-87be-413e-9ca2-ee5c807ce40e)

* **Automated communication**: Hidden Hand can automatically follow up with clients to get any missing information via text or email. Messages are automatically connected to any case management software, and everything is kept in one place.

### TLDR:

We are building [Revideo](https://re.video/), a web-based open-source framework that lets you create videos using the animation library Motion Canvas. It exposes basic video & audio editing functionality through a typescript API and lets you render videos with dynamic inputs. You can find our code on [**Github**](https://github.com/redotvideo/revideo)!

### **The Problem:**

We believe that AI will drastically change how people produce video and that huge amounts of video will soon be created in an automated manner. Initially, we wanted to build applications in this space ourselves and started to work on a few ideas. For example, we worked on an AI-based app to automatically create highlight videos for Twitch streamers, as well as a platform that lets companies A/B test video ads.

While building these products, we noticed that we weren’t really happy with the tooling we used. Most video editing frameworks lacked essential features, and the tools we liked were not open source. Therefore, we decided to build Revideo.

### **The Solution:**

We built Revideo by extending the animation library Motion Canvas and adding features that are essential for automatically creating videos. These features include support for audio, substantially faster video rendering, and an API for programmatically rendering videos with dynamic inputs.

launches.title: Haven: Fine-tune and run open source LLMs super fast ⚡
launches.tagline: Haven lets you build open source LLMs that are specialized for specific tasks
launches.body:
# TLDR:

We are excited to launch [Haven](https://haven.run/)’s fine-tuning platform for open source LLMs!

* Haven lets you fine-tune open source LLMs such as Llama or Mistral without writing code or setting up infrastructure. We charge $0.004/1k training tokens, and you get $5 in free credits after signing up
* You can host models for testing with <1s cold start times. We achieve this by running hundreds of model adapters on a single GPU and hot-swapping them based on user requests (will write more about this in a blog post)

You can get started [**here**](https://app.haven.run/) - alternatively, reach out to [**hello@haven.run**](https://app.haven.run/) or watch our [demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XpyVKUyt7k8) if you want to learn more!

### **The Problem**

Over the last months, we’ve identified two big pain points that make it hard to work with open source models:

1. Open source models work best when they are trained for specific use cases, but the fine-tuning process with existing tools is super annoying. We have found that most of our time is spent setting up infrastructure to go from finishing a training run to actually testing our models, rather than actually writing code and improving our models
2. Hosting custom models is expensive. Running a single Llama-7B model in float16 requires at minimum an A10 GPU, which costs $700+ per month. To run ten or a hundred specialized models for common tasks, this would mean that we have a monthly AWS bill of $7,000 or $70,000, respectively.

### **The Solution**

Haven’s platform offers a super simple way to fine-tune models without managing infrastructure or writing code, and to test and run them with low costs and without any additional work.

We are able to provide a super short feedback loop of going from training to running a fine-tuned model by hosting multiple lora adapters in parallel. This makes it possible for us to host hundreds of fine-tuned models on-demand on a single GPU. For our users, this reduced model cold start times to <1s and internally, we are able to host a single fine-tuned model for a couple of dollars per month. We also enable our users to export their model weights to Huggingface, so that they can run models entirely on their terms.

### **Our Ask**

Feel free to check out our [**platform**](https://app.haven.run/) and give us feedback! After signing up, you’ll receive $5 in credits to train a couple of models :) We are also happy to answer questions at [**hello@haven.run**](https://app.haven.run/)

launches.title: 🔮 Haven - Run LLMs on Your Own Cloud
launches.tagline: Haven makes it easy to deploy LLMs on your own infrastructure
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Haven makes it easy to deploy LLMs in your GCP / AWS environment. We provide the user experience of serverless solutions like Replicate or Huggingface Inference Endpoints - but instead of running your models on Haven’s servers, we just manage your infrastructure for you. This gives you full control over your data and you get to use your precious cloud credits!

### **🤕 The Problem**

Many companies want to use large language models but do not want to rely on third-party providers as it makes them dependent on external services and comes with significant privacy risks.

However, deploying models in-house is just not easy: engineers have to figure out CUDA environments, write and containerize efficient serving code, and expose it as an API server. And let’s not even talk about scalability…

Haven solves this problem. We offer the simplicity, reliability, and scalability of third-party providers while allowing our users to securely run models on their own infrastructure.

### **🤯 How It Works**

Haven is built on top of Kubernetes, which makes it easy to scale and reliable in production settings. Deploying a model with Haven consists of just three steps:

**1\. Upload a Service Account Key**

Uploading a service account key gives Haven permission to manage your cloud resources for you. Under the hood, Haven will now set up a Kubernetes cluster running in your cloud environment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73716&key=user_uploads/1023703/6b35bcd0-f0f5-4f4b-b3ab-dbb6a46261ff)

**2\. Configure Your Deployment**

You can now choose your model, select the GPUs you want it to run on, and configure the scaling behavior of your deployment. Haven will accordingly set up the model in your Kubernetes cluster.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73716&key=user_uploads/1023703/59c94edb-14a5-4e4e-b173-a4b19223ebdb)

**3\. Enjoy Your Model**

Your LLM is up and running in minutes! Our deployments offer super-fast inference and advanced features like input batching for efficient serving. This way, you can immediately integrate them into your application.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73716&key=user_uploads/1023703/773c461a-05ba-48b2-ba96-6b4c88d23cbf)

### **💪 The Team**

We’re Konstantin and Justus. The two of us met as freshmen in college, and have since built multiple projects together.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73716&key=user_uploads/1023703/95a23ea8-c105-4d8d-af62-f2a527bb50f7)

[Justus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justus-mattern-a04230184/) is an AI researcher and has been working on LLMs since 2020. As a member of AI labs at UC Berkeley and ETH Zürich, he has published multiple papers at leading research conferences.

[Konstantin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/konsti-h/) has already been a full-time software engineer before starting his university studies. At Germany’s biggest social networking company, he built infrastructure handling requests from millions of daily users.

### **💜 Our Ask**

**Sign up **[**here**](https://vkg6c80ex61.typeform.com/to/IMCFY5Cf)** to work with us!**

We are working closely with our users to fully understand the needs of companies aiming to integrate LLMs into their products. Beyond giving access to our deployment tool, we partner with early customers to evaluate their use cases and fine-tune models for their needs. If this sounds interesting, sign up for early access or contact us at [hello@haven.run](mailto:hello@haven.run)!

**Refer us to companies looking to use LLMs!**

If you have connections at companies looking to use LLMs, we’d highly appreciate introductions! You can reach us at [hello@haven.run](mailto:hello@haven.run).

launches.tagline: We help online stores improve ad performance and attribution accuracy through better tracking.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [**Converge**](https://www.runconverge.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch-yc) auto-tracks and forwards ecommerce customer events like Add To Cart and Purchase to analytics and ad platforms for accurate attribution and better ad performance.

### **Problem: Tracking for ecommerce is broken**

Correct attribution and conversion tracking is at the core of every ecommerce business.

However, tracking setups suffer from..

* **Missing** **data**: Stores miss on avg. \~10-30% of conversions due to limitations of browser tracking (e.g. ad-blockers) resulting in _broken attribution data and wasted ad budget._
* **Poor observability:** Popular tools like Google Tag Manager provide no way to check whether tracking is still working, resulting in _costly bugs that remain undiscovered._
* **Cluttered configurations:** Operators often loose grip on their tracking setup after years of uncoordinated updates, resulting in a clutter of pixels, tags, and first-party integrations across multiple platforms.
* **Lack of developers:** Many ecommerce teams don't have in-house devs, making it infeasible for them to integrate with existing CDP tools such as Segment.

## **Solution: Accurate auto-tracking**

Converge tracks all important events automatically – across the browser, store backend and subscription platforms. No technical expertise required.

Because conversions are being tracked on the store backend rather than the browser, Converge can track 100% of conversions and forward these to relevant ad platforms and analytics tools.

Unlike Segment or other CDPs, Converge allows non-technical ecommerce operators to set this tracking up in minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72382&key=user_uploads/772323/7f38e933-f6ce-489f-abf6-cd11149e83d1)

Once tracking is set up, Converge aggregates data from all sources and provides a single overview of ecommerce KPIs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72382&key=user_uploads/772323/5eb15873-3ea8-4e32-8e96-2efa057df4d7)

Users can also break down attribution metrics across channels, campaigns, adsets, and even ads, showing what is driving growth on a granular level.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72382&key=user_uploads/772323/eb78601f-2d1a-4a75-a35b-f5e7db168d3f)

## **Our ask**

* Sign up for [**Converge**](https://www.runconverge.com?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch-yc) today and test it for free!
* If you know any **ecommerce brands or agencies**, we would love to chat!

Hey everyone, I’m [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-puri1/) - founder of Smobi 👋

# **📖 TLDR**

Smobi is the AI-powered platform for branded, interactive business messaging, starting with RCS. We **help businesses send rich, personalized texts** that build trust, drive engagement, and create real conversations.

If SMS messaging is part of your strategy, we’d love to show you how you can do more!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oJkl6m7RxgI

Modern customer engagement is broken. Despite the abundance of messaging channels - email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app notifications, and voice - most brand communications feel impersonal, transactional, and spammy. **Consumers are overwhelmed with noise**:

* 82% of consumers received a spam text in the past week
* 70% of consumers will penalize a business for a poor communication experience
* 35% of consumers are annoyed by impersonalized and irrelevant content

Messages go unread. Calls go unanswered. Engagement is at an all time low. The problem is clear, all of us have felt it.

RCS addresses these issues with verified, branded, and interactive messages and it is finally here in the US. However most businesses don’t know it exists, and the few that do are still figuring out how to use it.

**Smobi changes that**. We know exactly how to unlock RCS to drive real value.

With Smobi, you can:

* 📊 Analyze every tap, interaction, and read

We also handle the strict carrier vetting and compliance, so you don’t have to.

launches.tagline: Bringing main-street business acquisitions to the 21st century
launches.body:
# Overview

Hi everyone, we’re [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-puri1/) and [Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mning1598/) from [Smobi](https://smobimarket.com/)!

Smobi is a marketplace that makes it **easy for buyers** to purchase brick & mortar small businesses. We do this by **verifying business listing data** and **managing deal-flow** on our platform.

Website: [smobimarket.com](http://smobimarket.com)

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fc69c6f56-e67a-45b9-904d-ee8c7ea7f4f0_3456x1812.png)

### **The Problem:**

* Buyers have to go through numerous listings to find quality businesses because most listings are **incomplete and misrepresented**
* Business brokers and owners who are looking to sell, **waste their time** working with buyers who aren’t qualified to purchase their business
* In the past 30 years, technology has only changed the business for sale market in **two** ways:
  * Listings have moved online instead of being in the local newspaper
  * Financial documents are emailed instead of being sent via mail
* The baby boomer generation is retiring over the next decade, who owns **1\.4 million businesses** that will close their doors unless they are sold to someone willing to buy them

### **The Solution:**

For those looking to buy, we utilize first and third party data to screen listings, so buyers are looking at the complete picture of the business that is for sale. Buyers can keep track of the state of each of the listings they are interested in and manage deal flow on the platform.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c68aba5-bbb6-4d50-9daf-4afef20fb191_3456x1822.png)

Additionally, we create NDA protected data rooms with more in-depth documents for each listing on our website. If the broker / seller of the business thinks you’re a good match for buying the business, we send the data room to the buyer.

For those looking to sell their business, we create a comprehensive profile for each buyer that is interested in a listing that the seller has created. Using data that the buyer has provided and our internal business logic, we classify how well of a match a person is for your business, ultimately saving time in your search for a buyer.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F465d0d7a-7313-4cb9-a80a-e6011294ea8c_3454x1828.png)

### **Our Vision:**

Our long term vision is to **digitize the entire acquisition process** for main-street businesses, ultimately making small business ownership attainable for everyone.

### **Who Are We?**

Hi everyone, we are Kunal and Michael, and we are building Smobi. Our mission is to make small business ownership attainable by everyone.

Kunal formerly worked in Amazon Advertising, where he built several notification delivery channels that supported 10B+ communications annually. Kunal spent over 6 months in 2022 looking to purchase multiple SMBs and found the process of finding and purchasing a business to be extremely complex, especially for a first time buyer.

Before Smobi, Michael worked at another YC startup, Dover, as an early engineer where he worked on growth initiatives and building AI products.

Kunal and Michael grew up together, have known each other for 10 years, and now both reside in NYC. Together, we are attempting to simplify the small business acquisition process for all parties involved.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73135&key=user_uploads/846621/2ed626b9-972e-4a72-84c0-fe19ecf48dee)

### **Our Asks**

Thank you for reading about Smobi! We welcome any feedback for our platform as we are just beginning!

* **Sign up today**: Sign up and browse 700+ businesses for sale and get notified when businesses come up for sale tailored to your preferences.
* **Join our newsletter**: Sign up for our [blog](https://smobi.com/blog) for guides on how to buy and sell SMBs!
* **Give us your feedback**: Tell us more about what criteria and information you would want before purchasing a SMB
* **Connect us**: Help us connect with SBA approved lenders, business brokers, people looking to purchase small businesses, and owners looking to sell their business

launches.title: Nowadays AI: AI-Native Platform for Corporate Meetings & Events
launches.tagline: The AI-native platform that sources venues, negotiates contracts, and runs your entire corporate event, so your team just shows up
launches.body:
Hey everyone!! We're Anna and Amy, sisters, co-founders, and the people who used to manually call 20 hotels for a single offsite.

We launched Nowadays on YC S23 as an "AI copilot for event planning." Two years later, we want to show you what we actually built :)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/709549e5-8a04-4b5c-8557-76886ff145a0)

# **TL;DR**

Nowadays is the AI-native platform for corporate retreats and meetings. Tell us what you need: we handle venue sourcing, contract negotiation, room blocks, attendee logistics, and post-event reconciliation. Fortune 500 teams and fast-growing startups use Nowadays to run offsites they're proud of, without burning out their ops team.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/53908cc7-1f81-4c15-afe7-5e0f11b7ad59)

# **The Problem**

Planning a corporate offsite is a second job nobody signed up for.

Your EA or ops lead spends weeks cold-emailing hotels, chasing RFPs, deciphering hotel contracts, and manually tracking room blocks in spreadsheets, only to do it all over again next quarter.

The vendors in this space are slow and expensive. Many of our customers have said the same thing: "I got paired with a planner worse than myself."

The result: overpriced venues, cancellation penalties nobody caught, and an ops team that's exhausted before the event even starts. And for most enterprises, 65% of meeting spend is completely unmanaged, buried in expense reports, booked by admins outside any system.

# **Our Solution**

Nowadays replaces the entire event planning stack with one AI-native platform, backed by a team that actually executes on your behalf. You tell us what you need. We handle the rest. Your team just shows up.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/67abf2bb-7640-4684-9bbf-c2bfb3a85d4a)

## **1. AI-powered venue sourcing**

Describe your event, dates, headcount, vibe, budget, and we generate a curated shortlist of venues with proposals in 24 hours, not weeks. We have relationships with 400K+ hotels globally and we're a certified IATA travel agency.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/cedeb56d-e591-4eed-a1f6-b75d1eabf9b5)

## **2. Contract negotiation, handled**

We negotiate directly with venues on your behalf, pushing on room rates, F&B minimums, attrition clauses, and cancellation terms. Our AI knows market rates from thousands of events and pushes back when hotels overcharge. Clients routinely save 20-30% vs. going direct.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/1156b34d-e9b9-4e1d-bc9a-7736a13901a9)

## **3. Exclusive rates**

We aggregate demand across all our clients to secure rates individual companies can't get on their own.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/592bb426-c3e7-4457-ab13-860504f2fc0e)

## **4. End-to-end logistics**

Room blocks, cutoff dates, rooming lists, supplier coordination, tracked in one place, managed by us. Nothing falls through the cracks while you're onsite.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/49563edb-1c99-4cc1-afbd-d590b691258f)

## **5. Attendee registration and logistics**

Custom registration forms, dietary needs, t-shirt sizes, room assignments, all in the platform. Your ops lead is not managing 12 spreadsheets.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/302d0f5a-5d1c-4b01-8cdc-32bffe7d01e8)

## **6. Expert support**

Every client gets a dedicated Nowadays partner who knows your program, your preferences, and your budget. Our AI acts, and when you need a human, we're there.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/2afea73a-7a20-4209-b1b7-e2ded68d6a13)

## **7. Post-event reconciliation**

We audit the final folio, catch billing errors, and close the loop financially. No more surprise charges two weeks after everyone's home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/836fcdff-8837-4754-b447-cda95c651c11)

## **Why we're different**

Every competitor you've heard of bolted AI onto infrastructure built decades ago. We built around AI from day one, which is why a small team can do at scale what legacy platforms need armies of account managers to do.

Our AI calls venues in 22 languages, parses 50-page proposals into clean apples-to-apples comparisons, and routes every meeting through approval workflows, including the small ones EAs used to book on their own.

One Fortune 500 VP uncovered $18M in previously unmanaged meeting spend just by turning Nowadays on.

# **Use Cases**

* Quarterly offsites: for remote-first teams who need to meet all their new employees
* Leadership retreats: for executive teams running strategic planning sessions
* Sales kickoffs: with complex AV, F&B, and multi-day programming needs
* International group travel: we handle the complexity of multi-country logistics end to end

# **Where We Are Now**

We work with companies ranging from ones planning one epic kickoff a year to ones running thousands of meetings through the platform annually. Clients include Google, Airbnb, BlackRock, Anthropic, Pylon, and Mintlify.

We've run retreats from San Diego to Thailand, from 20-person leadership offsites to 500+ person company kickoffs.

We won both judges' choice and people's choice at Business Travel Show America 2025 and Business Travel Show APAC 2026, the two biggest innovation competitions in corporate travel.

# **Why Now**

Corporate travel spend is back and growing. But the infrastructure for planning events hasn't caught up. Legacy travel companies are slow, opaque, and not built for the modern distributed workforce. We're rebuilding this from scratch with AI at the core and a team that treats every event like it's our own.

# **We're growing!!**

We're hiring across the board for founding team members, engineers, operators, and account executives who want to work on a problem that's genuinely hard and unsolved, with a really fun team in San Francisco.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103278&key=user_uploads/1347384/6174eee6-ebce-4c88-8465-b443a7584c55)

See open roles: [nowadays.ai/careers](https://nowadays.ai/careers)

# **Get started**

Book a call: [meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan](http://meetings-na2.hubspot.com/amy-yan)

Email us: [events@nowadays.ai](mailto:events@nowadays.ai)

launches.tagline: AI Agent that improves your product while you sleep
launches.body:
We want you to [meet Ruby.](https://ion.design/ruby)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92019&key=user_uploads/608990/d2392f00-7f84-408c-b2dd-3ad45be16407)

**tl;dr:** You can assign Ruby design tasks right in slack, like optimizing a flow or creating a new page.

She clarifies requirements, researches, designs multiple options, iterates with you, and ships PRs to your codebase. She will then monitor performance and suggest future improvements.

She’s like Devin, but for Product Design work.

2 min demo - [**https://youtu.be/0MccwmsZOOc?si=FqSIPUbiX-Y160h8**](https://youtu.be/0MccwmsZOOc?si=FqSIPUbiX-Y160h8)

### Problem

“Over the next decade, as new coding tools make it easier than ever to build and ship products quickly, great design is going to matter even more.” - Aaron Epstein, latest YC RFS

We agree, and good design takes a LOT of time, money, and care. Ruby can leverage your design thinking and execute against it 100x faster.

Whenever you build a flow, you can be sure Ruby will make it as good as it can be.

### How ruby helps

When assigned a task, ruby works through a flow to solve the problem:

1. **Clarify:** Ruby asks your team the right questions until the requirements are clear.
2. **Research:** Ruby scans usage data, research docs, personas, and finds external inspo.
3. **Design & Test:** Ruby generates multiple concepts that follow your brand and design system. She simulates usage and discards weak options. She will iterate until she is confident the problem is being solved.
4. **Iterate:** Ruby presents her work, takes feedback, and refines. She can iterate endlessly.
5. **Ship:** Opens a PR when you approve a design.
6. **Improve:** Ruby will monitor your analytics and propose upgrades whenever she spots opportunities.

### Why did we build this?

Our team was early in generative code & design. I’ve been shipping ai design-to-code tools since 2021, and we recently built an AI visual builder called ion.

Internally, we trained an AI that uses our visual builder itself, and taught it the design process.

It blew us away.

We named her Ruby, put her into slack, and started giving her to our customers. Her results look promising so we’re sharing her more 🙂

### Our ask

[**Ruby**](https://ion.design/ruby) is meant for fast moving startups who are serious about getting product changes in the hands of customers faster.

If you want faster experimentation and world‑class design without extra headcount, [**grab a slot on our calendar.**](https://cal.com/samraaj/15min) We are personally onboarding the first batch of customers.

[Demo (2 minutes)](https://youtu.be/qF0Ery_eqRA)

### Safe “vibe coding”, made for your team

* **Built for your codebase:** ion connects to your github and understands your set up (design system, tokens, components, version control) to ensure changes use existing patterns and fit architecture. Setup takes seconds.
* **Easy for non-technical team:** ion serves a figma-like experience, so PMs and designers have a familiar interface to make product changes. ion automatically opens PRs so your usual review process stays intact.
* **Faster Iteration:** No more endless backlogs, Figma → Dev → QA loops, or “design doc limbo.” ion makes smaller (but crucial) changes easy, and keeps your engineers focused on the big stuff.

### Problem

Product teams are split in to two camps:

* Those who can ship (engineers).
* Those who can’t ship (PMs, designers, marketers, etcc)

Small changes—marketing pages, design tweaks, growth experiments—get stuck behind bigger features and developer bandwidth.

But they’re inherently different work and shouldn’t be at odds with one another.

### Solution

With ion, your entire product team gains the ability to ship through a simple visual editor.

Your team can either point and describe their changes through natural language, or enter “design mode” to get a Figma-like editor built on top of your codebase.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89341&key=user_uploads/608990/d37e63ab-9b64-4323-b5cc-01b434303621)

ion automatically wires everything into GitHub branches/PRs, so you still maintain engineering rigor.

Engineers are freed up to focus on **high-leverage** work (architecture, data, business logic), while non-technical folks self-serve on UI changes, experiments, front end, and other changes.

### How it’s being used today:

* **Rapid Product Iteration**
  * Instead of back-and-forth on Slack or Loom videos, designers/PMs can open an ion link for a given branch, visually tweak what’s needed, and ship updated PRs.
* **Design Fixes**
  * Designers fix design issues directly within ion rather than piling up a backlog of styling tickets. Some teams even skip Figma altogether for minor tweaks.
* **Growth & Marketing**
  * Launch new landing pages, promotions, or experiments at lightning speed. No more waiting on the dev queue for something as simple as a copy change.

### Our ask

ion has already shipped thousands of lines of code at companies of all sizes. If you’re interested in unlocking the development productivity of your team,  please reach out:

* Email us at founders@ion.design
* [Book some time to chat on my calendar](https://cal.com/samraaj/15min)
* [Download ion now - it’s free to start 🙂](https://ion.design/)

Hi everyone 👋🏽🧡. [Samraaj](https://linkedin.com/in/samraajbath) and [Samuel](https://linkedin.com/in/samuel-barnholdt-a480b3179) here from [ion design](https://www.ion.design/). We’re super excited to share what we’ve been working on with you!

**tldr:**

ion design automatically turns Figma designs into pixel-perfect, production-ready code, speeding up front-end implementation time by at least 40%.

We accomplish this by serving a fully featured Figma design system and matching React component library. This allows our generations to come out with incredibly high-quality, functional code that saves hours of time.

Think of us like UntitledUI and Shadcn on steroids - we speed up both the design and implementation processes.

**Deal:**

Our design system with 5,000+ custom components is available for just $10 for the first 100 customers - [get access here](https://buy.stripe.com/28o1739KTcx59Vu8wB?prefilled_promo_code=YCLAUNCH24)

Here’s a quick demo of our design system being used to generate a production-ready application:

[DEMO](https://youtu.be/81kUjZUXaxQ)

[Demo Application - Figma](https://www.figma.com/file/LncZWxVTpD4svqEUVk63pC/ion-demo-application?type=design&node-id=105%3A4665&mode=design&t=CW5GRxhuZBUGbc6t-1)

[Demo Application - GitHub](https://github.com/ion-design/ion-demo-application)

[Demo Application - Live Link](https://ion-demo-application.vercel.app/)

# The Problem - implementing designs is expensive, painful, and monotonous.

Design and front-end engineering is re-doing the same work twice. We think this is ridiculous, and a total waste of time for businesses that leads to a multitude of problems:

* **Engineers feel like they are wasting their time** monotonously writing CSS to match pixels in Figma. They would prefer to focus on more interesting work that drives value - like business logic, architecture, and data. They also hate working with primitives and want useable components out-of-the-box.
* **Designers feel that there’s always a disconnect** between what they made and production. They’re constrained by engineering bottlenecks and their fixes will never be live. Many want a system they can put in place so the organization can be more structured and consistent.
* **PMs & Founders hate having to prioritize design changes** against product iterations and new feature releases. They wish that the design work could just get done.

# ⚡ Solution - The ion system

ion serves a customizable design system & component library that can be synced with your codebase ✨automatically✨.

We’re the first UI-kit that’s tightly coupled between Figma and React and works with out-of-the-box code generation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78764&key=user_uploads/608990/40106740-b0ff-42ca-8502-5f2138f80e84)

Here are some killer features:

* ion automatically re-uses your existing components and writes READABLE code that your engineers can interface with.
* ion writes stub functions and state handlers for your buttons, inputs, text areas, tabs, and other complicated components, automatically.
* ion raises merge conflicts for design changes and soon will be able to create pull requests directly in your repo.
* ion keeps you consistent, clean, and quick in your development. Oftentimes, the generated code is cleaner and easier to work with than what I write.

Using ion also saves your designers thousands of hours by serving 5,000+ well-built Figma components. This empowers you to design faster and maintain consistency across your application. Here’s a gif of me creating a screen in a matter of minutes:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78764&key=user_uploads/608990/87b26b94-5a26-4e5e-bec1-fe31c3a8e742)

Our design system is endlessly theme-able and syncs directly with the CSS variables in your codebase. Light mode and dark mode are baked into the system.

Say goodbye to re-writing classnames and pulling your hair out to get things to look good. You can even add whatever custom themes you want.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78764&key=user_uploads/608990/8f4f009c-a9e8-423a-ace6-db1a05008e4c)

* **1 - 3% conversion rates** at best from e-commerce emails

* In-email one-click subscription upsell

As a PM, Co-founder [Santi](https://linkedin.com/in/gomezpaz) led Turing.com to adopt interactive emails after proving out a 3x conversion rate boost in A/B tests. After unsuccessfully searching for 3rd-party tools, his team built the functionality into their internal tool.

launches.body:
> **TL;DR:**

[_Resonance_](https://www.useresonance.com/) _is an ad server for house ads (self-promotional marketing). Companies use Resonance as a one-stop shop for campaign creation, intelligent experimentation/prioritization, analytics, and impression management to boost net revenue retention following user onboarding._ [_Schedule a demo_](https://calendly.com/jonathantou/quick-chat) or [_get in contact_](https://www.useresonance.com/contact).

> **The Team:**

I used to work as a SWE at Dropbox, DoorDash, and Microsoft. In particular, I helped build a similar platform to Resonance at Dropbox that generated $100 million ARR. I wanted to start Resonance because 1) I felt there were many ways to improve that particular tool and 2) I wanted to bring that tool to other companies that need it but don’t have the bandwidth to build it themselves.

> **The Problem:**

For companies that depend on product-led growth (primarily consumer/SMB/startup-centric companies), their website remains their most valuable marketing channel. Post-user onboarding, these companies rely on in-product messaging to drive feature adoption so they can retain users.

Unfortunately, this sort of strategy only works at scale, and there are many challenges in doing so. Below are some non-trivial functionalities that modern companies require to launch effective campaigns with velocity:

1. Code-based and no-code workflows for launching campaigns
2. Campaign performance analytics
3. Intelligent campaign targeting and experimentation
4. Sophisticated campaign impression management
5. UX flexibility (i.e. messaging should not be limited just to overlays)

Solving this problem is crucial, as millions in ARR is left on the table if companies cannot properly scale their in-product feature discovery/awareness/education. Companies like Dropbox that have built tooling to address the above challenges have generated up to $100 million ARR from the increased user retention.

> **The Solution:**

Solving this problem requires building a centralized system where any stakeholder (technical or non-technical) can effortlessly launch campaigns to drive in-product feature adoption.

Holistic assessment of campaign performance, global impression management, and optimized campaign targeting can only work at scale if there is a single system that serves as a repository for all campaigns and governs campaign creation.

Resonance addresses this by providing a central platform where developers and non-developers can both easily launch in-product feature adoption campaigns within minutes, with the above functionalities provided out of the box.

Below are screenshots of some important features in our UI (and there are many more).

* No code builder with live preview on your website and experimentation
  * (**NOTE**: The preview will obviously be with your website and UI components - disregard my modal and website)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79089&key=user_uploads/570574/7339d733-3683-43bd-9fac-f23d881bfdf4)

* Complex User Targeting

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79089&key=user_uploads/570574/cc3cd9e1-809f-499e-b871-934e27807a38)

* Sophisticated Frequency Management
  * (**NOTE**: We also have similar rules that apply globally for all campaigns)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79089&key=user_uploads/570574/f1b8a942-dc12-440f-8680-6c4dee517be4)

* Global Analytics

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79089&key=user_uploads/570574/62457d65-c845-48ff-8877-569dfa707544)

* Intelligent Experimentation (experiment up to 7x faster with 4-8x more variants)

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79089&key=user_uploads/570574/53430985-a9d3-4c17-97eb-52bc56285c86)


> Our Ask

1. If you are a product-led company, shipping a lot of features, or are using something like Intercom or Pendo, I’d love to set up some time here to chat about improving your user retention. I’m familiar with existing tools and I believe I can do a much better job.
2. If not, I’d appreciate an intro to anyone in your network who works in a senior role within growth or product if possible.

launches.title: Toma, an AI Platform for the $2T Automotive Industry
launches.tagline: Toma is on a mission to build world-class communication and support tools for America's high ticket industries, starting with automotive.
launches.body:
### **Next-Gen Voice AI in a $2T Industry that Silicon Valley Overlooks**

We’re thrilled to share that Toma [**raised a $17M Series A**](https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/05/tomas-ai-voice-agents-have-taken-off-at-car-dealerships-and-attracted-funding-from-a16z/), led by **Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)**, who chose us after vetting every voice AI company in automotive. The wild part is that we got here through just word-of-mouth sales, without a sales team, and now power **hundreds of customers** across the U.S.

Since graduating from YC, we’ve gone knee-deep into a trillion-dollar industry historically neglected by Silicon Valley––automotive dealerships. We’ve spent half a year **living in them** to learn how they communicate with their customers, run their day-to-day operations, and provide both great and (usually) not-so-great customer experiences. To put it simply, **things are broken**.

So we built AI agents that fix it by:

* Deploying **personalized agents**
* **Automating inbound calls** with a low-latency, natural-sounding voice AI
* Running **outbound SMS** campaigns that generate new revenue
* **Deeply integrating** with automotive-specific software
* Offering **insights and reporting** into every AI/customer interaction
* Intelligently **alerting customers** when human intervention is needed

We’re now the **fastest-growing** AI platform in automotive, and we’re just getting started.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/65a56669-51b7-40ff-ad8e-4c443df5a09c)

### **From YC Hack Project to Must-Have AI Employee**

We started Toma as **two engineers** ([Monik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/monikp/) & [Anthony](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anthonykrivonos/)) who didn’t want to build another generic chatbot. We flew around the country, shadowing advisors in hot service bays, listening to call recordings, and mapping dealership workflows in Figma. We **wrote code inside dealerships** as bugs and feature ideas were discovered alongside our users.

We took a YC prototype and turned it into a real product. Today, dealerships such as [Martin Management Group](https://www.toma.com/resources/case-study/how-ai-doubled-operational-margins-for-martin-management-group) and [Middletown Honda](https://www.toma.com/resources/case-study/how-toma-helps-middletown-honda-save-100k-annually) rely on Toma to handle **tens of thousands of calls** monthly. Calls that were previously missing entirely or requiring thousands of dollars to outsource to call centers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/3a60abaf-e5fd-437a-8b4c-f38d911f215e)

### **The Results Are Wild**

* **Martin Management Group:** 9,000 service appointments booked in 90 days. $2M+ in revenue. 40% reduction in BDC workload.
* **Middletown Honda:** 53% of inbound calls handled by AI. $100K+ saved annually. Zero missed calls during recall events.
* **Nationwide:** Over 1 million call minutes handled by Toma since launch. Hundreds of thousands of hours of human time saved.
* **Growth:** Surpassed 7-figures in ARR in less than one year while approaching 8 figures with over 100 dealerships using Toma across the U.S.

The best part is that vehicle owners love it, dealers love it, and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) love it because **Toma works very well**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/85178e79-dde7-4ec7-b19e-b28691d601a4)

### **Why This Industry Matters (and Why It’s Underserved)**

Cars are essential to how Americans live, work, and move, and they’re getting older. The average vehicle on the road is 12.6 years old. That means **more maintenance, more service calls, and more pressure** on dealerships to deliver better experiences.

Silicon Valley has historically **ignored this space**. It’s messy, full of edge cases, and utilizes antiquated software, requiring a deep understanding of real-world operations. **That’s where we thrive.** We see a gold rush in how AI can revolutionize the automotive retail industry.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/e94c67ce-14f4-4b8a-8648-3b105052b1d9)

### **Why This Industry is Just the Beginning**

**Automotive** is one of many high-ticket, operationally complex industries in the U.S.—alongside insurance, home services, logistics, and healthcare—where communication is still largely **manual**, software is **legacy**, and workflows are deeply **idiosyncratic**.

These industries are slow-moving but massive, with billions of dollars lost every year due to inefficiencies. While we’re laser-focused on fixing communication in dealerships, Toma is **building the horizontal foundation for deploying production-grade AI assistants** across every high-value, high-friction service industry. We believe the future of operations will be AI-augmented, and we’re laying the rails.

### **The Tech**

**In-house**, we have built:

* A SOTA **voice AI orchestration** pipeline
* **Dynamic integration platform** for connecting to legacy software
* Production-grade **agentic workflow** engine
* **Agent evaluation** pipelines
* **Prompt management** tools that allow us to support hundreds of customers as a 3-person ops team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/2c4115f8-a2bf-433b-b7f3-30f4fa6ca0c3)

### **Our Culture: Builders First, Always**

Toma was **built by engineers**, and we hire technically-minded people across all responsibilities. We move quickly, fix things, and build from the ground up. We care deeply about real-world impact and meticulous attention to detail.

We’re backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Scale Angels, Flex Capital, Holman Automotive, and more. But more than anything, we’re backed by many of our own dealerships and their staff, who trust us to communicate with their customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92511&key=user_uploads/416691/9eeaaa4c-ba17-4927-82b9-230c362a3684)

### **Who We're Looking For**

You might be a fit if you:

* Want to build **cutting-edge AI features** and work on SOTA everything
* Are **disillusioned by AI slop** products and want to solve real-world problems
* Want **excessive ownership** of critical systems and infrastructure
* Have a **high bar of excellence** and want to work with people who match your energy

If you’re curious, please join us in building the future of AI-powered automotive retail operations. We’re a small team, but we punch above our weight and are having a blast doing it.

👉 [www.toma.com/jobs](http://www.toma.com/jobs)

These industries are slow-moving but massive, with billions of dollars lost every year due to inefficiencies. While we’re laser-focused on fixing communication in dealerships, Toma is **building the horizontal foundation for deploying production-grade AI assistants** across every high-value, high-friction service industry. We believe the future of operations will be AI-augmented, and we’re laying the rails.

* A SOTA **voice AI orchestration** pipeline
* **Dynamic integration platform** for connecting to legacy software
* Production-grade **agentic workflow** engine
* **Agent evaluation** pipelines
* **Prompt management** tools that allow us to support hundreds of customers as a 3-person ops team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92512&key=user_uploads/416691/2c4115f8-a2bf-433b-b7f3-30f4fa6ca0c3)

### **Our Culture: Builders First, Always**

Toma was **built by engineers**, and we hire technically-minded people across all responsibilities. We move quickly, fix things, and build from the ground up. We care deeply about real-world impact and meticulous attention to detail.

We’re backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Scale Angels, Flex Capital, Holman Automotive, and more. But more than anything, we’re backed by many of our own dealerships and their staff, who trust us to communicate with their customers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92512&key=user_uploads/416691/9eeaaa4c-ba17-4927-82b9-230c362a3684)

### **Who We're Looking For**

You might be a fit if you:

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: When we were heading Growth at Twitter, we saw the power of copy changes. **When we tweaked a push notification from “Elon tweeted” to “Elon _just_ tweeted”, we gained 800K additional users.** We never underestimated the power of copy since that day. The company funded it as a big investment in the difficult years when Twitter’s growth was tanking. However, each change would take 3-6 months to pick, test, approve, and ship. We also didn’t know how to use those learnings systematically to prioritize the next copy change. We started building internal tools to automate this and gained 20% additional user growth. We stumbled upon similar problems and “vision docs” at Pinterest. We knew we were staring at money on the table. We quit our jobs to build [just words](https://justwords.ai).

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Today, lifecycle marketing is built on manual effort — copywriters brainstorming variants, data scientists running A/B tests, and marketers trying to make sense of disconnected dashboards. Every campaign is a one-off experiment.

In the world we’re building, **AI-marketers** will handle this entire loop — strategy, creation, optimization, and learning — with humans acting as orchestrators, not operators.

* Campaigns will **self-evolve**: AI agents will detect new opportunities, write and test messages, measure outcomes, and continuously improve.
* Brands will move from **batch campaigns** to **living systems** — always-on, hyper-personalized, cross-channel journeys that adapt in real time.
* Every marketer, no matter their company size, will have access to enterprise-level intelligence — a strategist, a creative, an optimizer, and a data scientist — all in one AI team.

The world will shift from “humans using tools” to **humans teaming with AI agents**.\
And in doing so, we’ll make personalization not just scalable, but truly human again — every message relevant, every experience intelligent, every brand empathetic at scale.

Our AI Creative Strategist:

You finally find a winning creative and you replicate it - make 5 variations. But almost all of them fail - high CAC and wasted $ on production.

Why? _Because you didn’t really know WHAT made the ad work!_

Creatives have 100s of moving parts and it’s impossible to find patterns manually. So most marketers make an educated guess, which often leads to unpredictability & low hit rate.

**Guess what works —> Low hit rate —> Poor CAC + wasted $ on prod**

1. **Find patterns that you miss**:

2. **Build a winning playbook**: 

   Every brand needs a playbook, a checklist that becomes the guiding principle of creative testing. We help you create this in terms of which hooks, messaging, format, music, CTAs, storylines, influencers etc. really work for you
3. **Get recommendations on what to launch next:** 

   Based on the patterns found + your brand’s playbook, we come up with a detailed creative brief every week that helps the creative team ship out ads faster than ever

* **Human in the loop:** Handles transfers to your human team at any time (cold or warm). Apten can also dynamically transfer to specific numbers depending on
* **Reliability:** setup custom guardrails that automatically detect non-compliant messages and proactively fix them before they’re sent to the lead

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/9cf399d9-e818-4bfb-9da4-42ac9ed3736f)

# **☕️ TL;DR**

* **Ape** is the ultimate **AI prompt engineer** 🐒, designed to optimize your prompts by reducing cost and latency while increasing performance.
* Ape achieves an **impressive 94.5%** on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%).
* **Easy to set up evaluation**: Ape can auto-generate evaluation code and use LLMs as a judge, or you can use your own eval metrics.
* Get set up in less than 15 minutes and see the difference.
  * [Schedule a meeting](https://cal.com/team/weavel/weavel-onboarding) to discover more. Let's chat! 🙂

# **🔒 Problem**

You’re an engineer of an LLM app, trying to get the prompts just right. Every time you type something in, the output changes—so you tweak a word here and there, and it changes again. Sometimes the outputs looks better, sometimes not. But you’re never sure. Hours go by, all spent on prompt engineering.

Getting the outputs you want can feel like an endless game of trial and error. And you’re not alone. Over the past few weeks, we’ve talked to over 100 YC companies, and a lot of them are facing the same challenges:

* **Measuring output quality is hard** (You’re heavily relying on manual evaluations at the moment.)
* **Prompt engineering does not work as you want** (You hate spending 5-7 hours a day searching for that one great prompt.)

# **🔑 Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/ddf5778d-78d0-4ff2-a4aa-b84624aeebc0)

We solve the problem with one simple formula:

```
good input + right guidance = better prompts
```

Today, we launch Ape, your first **AI Prompt Engineer**. Inspired by DSPy, Reflexion, Expel and other research papers, Ape iteratively improves your prompts. Here’s how Ape works:

1️⃣ Log your inputs and outputs to Weavel (with a single line of code!)

2️⃣ Let Ape filter the logs into datasets.

3️⃣ Ape then generates evaluation code and uses LLMs as judges for complex tasks.

4️⃣ As more production data is added, Ape continues refining and improving prompt performance.

### **How to use**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/0c1eeedd-ac08-40e7-ad35-acff6766c2c1)

**Create a Dataset**

Change just one line of code to start logging LLM calls with the Weavel Python SDK. The SDK supports sync/async OpenAI chat completions and OpenAI structured outputs.

You can also import existing data or manually create a dataset.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/bdfc79bd-edeb-4dbf-8c9b-7d432007fa3a)

**Create a Prompt**

Write a prompt that corresponds to your dataset. You can add an existing prompt as the base version, or if you prefer, create a blank prompt and provide a brief description for Ape to create a prompt from scratch.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/1bfacea3-c2d9-4ac8-90d7-9a6d3e37fd60)

**Optimize Prompts**

To optimize your prompt using Ape, fill in the necessary information (e.g. JSON schema as you want) and then run the optimization process. An enhanced version of your prompt will be created and available soon.

Ta-da! It’s that easy. Ape outperforms with a remarkable 94.5% score on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%). With Ape, you can optimize the prompt engineering process, saving tons of time and cost while increasing performance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/2002273/45b5ec84-f89d-4d57-9e20-ad349f521c97)

Ape is **open source**. [Check out our repository on GitHub.](https://github.com/weavel-ai/Ape) (We’d appreciate a star 🌟)

# **🚀 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/201595e0-e85e-4931-81aa-a9947754b1b4)

From left to right: [**Jun**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jun-park314/), [**Andrew**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sounhochung/), and [**HyunJie**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hyunjiejung/) — together we’re building Weavel.

**Andrew** and **Jun** built 10+ LLM-based products, open-sourced a prompt engineering platform, and co-authored a paper at a NeurIPS workshop last year. **HyunJie** worked on data analytics and optimization at Chartmetric and DevRev, and focused on growth marketing at Liner.

# **🙏 Ask**

* Try Ape! [Schedule](https://cal.com/team/weavel/weavel-onboarding) a walkthrough with the Weavel team or email [hyunjie@weavel.ai](mailto:hyunjie@weavel.ai).
* Share thoughts on our [Discord](https://weavel.ai/discord) or DM us on [Twitter](https://x.com/weaveldotai).
* If you know anyone struggling with prompt engineering or evaluations for LLM apps, connect them with us!
  * Copy & paste blurb: A YC company named Weavel has developed an AI prompt engineer (Ape in short) which continuously improves your prompts. It’ll save tons of time for you. You can grab a time [here](https://cal.com/team/weavel/weavel-onboarding) for a demo from the founders.

launches.body:
**TLDR;** Financial affiliate programs struggle to ensure affiliates are compliant with brand guidelines, leading to limited growth opportunities. [Affil](https://affil.ai/) monitors affiliate content, enabling companies to expand marketing efforts and maximize revenue.

_What is financial affiliate marketing?_ When you see content by The Points Guy or Forbes that talks about credit cards, checking accounts, etc, they get a kickback from the financial brand for anyone who successfully applies for the product.

### ⚠️ The Problem

Financial institutions (e.g., Capital One) or consumer fintech companies (e.g., Acorns) want to grow their affiliate programs but are completely blocked by compliance barriers. However, it’s expensive and time-intensive to do manual affiliate compliance & management.

On the flip side, affiliates are also dissatisfied with these financial affiliate programs. The majority have to work with disorganized & outdated middlemen hired by financial brands who take a significant cut of payouts.

### 🛠️ The Solution

Our AI compliance software monitors affiliate content so that financial companies know exactly what’s being said about them so that they can expand their marketing efforts:

* Track thousands of affiliate pages 
* Quickly identify compliance violations without needing human intervention
* Create support tickets for every issue, so affiliates & brands can keep track of errors

We’re also improving the affiliate experience:

* Offer higher payouts for conversions (since we have a lower cost structure)
* Provide a beautiful user experience & working APIs
* Proactively identify compliance risks & offer automated suggestions to minimize risk

For example (see below), the AMEX Gold Card underwent significant changes on July 27, 2024, but outdated affiliate content still exists on the internet (that’s not good). We caught this issue that both AMEX and Bankrate missed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83537&key=user_uploads/723194/ba92939d-54dd-48e3-96e2-92f6fd687240)

The big vision is to become the affiliate network that powers all financial institutions out there.

### 🧍‍♂️Our Team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83537&key=user_uploads/723194/876b50d9-2679-48a5-a7ae-e4623f56d47a)

[Vivek](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vivek-olumbe/) & [John](https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnta2000/) first met at Penn and cofounded the first personal finance nonprofit at 8 different colleges, accumulating 2.5k+ users and $25k+ in funding. Vivek is a full stack developer who worked for several startups shipping new products; John was previously in banking, strategy, and growth roles.

After managing affiliate relationships in a prior role & being involved with credit cards for years (fun fact: he has 30 cards), John realized the financial affiliate marketing space was broken. 

### 🤝 Our Ask

* **Leads:** Know anyone at a consumer finance company or publishers/content creators that write about credit cards/use affiliate links? We’d love an intro! 
* **Banking:** We are having particular struggles getting in contact with some of the key stakeholders at some of the major banks (think Chase, Wells Fargo, USAA…), so if you can make any warm intros to folks on the consumer banking side, I’ll buy you dinner!

Contact: founders@affil.ai

launches.body:
**TLDR: We’re building [Luthor](https://www.luthor.ai/):**  AI compliance infrastructure for regulated marketing

---

### <https://youtu.be/MvOLCnl-WHg>
\
**The Problem**

At most financial services companies, a simple marketing campaign can get stuck in legal and compliance review for weeks.

People send drafts over email, argue over disclosures in spreadsheets, lose context, and miss the market window.

With Luthor, teams upload content and instantly get:

* Checks against federal, state and international regulations
* Company policies and brand guidelines
* The right disclosures
* Suggestions based on past approvals and firm-specific rules

Everything then lives in one place for review, approval, and audit.

### **Who it’s for**

Our users today include:

* Financial Services (RIAs/Broker Dealers)
* Asset managers
* Banks/Credit unions
* Mortgage lenders
* Other regulated companies that run frequent campaigns

If you’re building in a regulated industry and deal with compliance-heavy marketing workflows, this might be relevant.

---

### **Why we started Luthor**

When I was on Square’s risk team, I built internal tools to manage compliance reviews.

Timing mattered. A campaign going out this week vs. next month could mean millions in volume.

But I kept seeing product launches miss their window, not because they were unsafe, but because the process was slow.

It was frustrating to watch good work get delayed by bad systems. That’s what led me to build Luthor.

---

### **What’s happened so far**

We’re live with financial services firms, mortgage lenders, marketing agencies, banks, and VC firms, and are piloting with an Am Law 10 firm.

Our customers collectively represent over **$850B+ in assets under management**.

Across teams, we’re seeing review cycles shrink from weeks to hours.

---

### **Asks**

If you work in marketing or compliance in a regulated industry and are tired of slow approvals and bottlenecks, we’d love to talk.

---

Book a call [here](https://cal.com/luthor/learn-more), or email [founders@luthor.ai](mailto:founders@luthor.ai) \
\
\-Glenn

name: Unusual
long_description:
AI agents are the newest audience brands need to speak to, but go-to-market teams don't have the tools to understand how they form opinions or make decisions.

Unusual helps brands in the Fortune 100 and scale-ups like Change.org and Astronomer drive more sales and win more market share by shifting how AI models perceive their offerings.

We work closely with every brand to (1) identify the root cause of AI misperception, (2) align on marketing, sales, and product strategies that appeal to agents, and (3) build infrastructure and content that makes their strongest proof more legible to agents.

Our methodology centers on applying black-box interpretability techniques to AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude to understand how they form opinions about a brand and its competitors. Seeing the *why* behind each opinion gives us the ability to create targeted interventions that change them.

launches.body:
Unusual creates and suggests media engineered to improve how AI talks about your brand – driving you more leads. This is the first “AI Relations” tool – public relations for AI models.

**The problem:**

Every day, your customers rely more on ChatGPT for their buying decisions. 

Getting tools like ChatGPT to send you leads is a lot more than GEO/AEO; it’s more like running a PR campaign – strategically building credibility and authority with models themselves.

**The solution:**

We built a platform that helps you improve AI’s holistic picture of your brand – what we’re calling “AI Relations.”

https://youtu.be/EIkyCu3kTt4 

We break this into three components, all of which Unusual manages:

1. Filling key knowledge gaps – publishing LLM-optimized content full of information LLMs are searching for, but don’t have: like a reference manual for your company. Check out ours here: https://llms.unusual.ai  
2. Getting you on the map – flagging the 3rd party media sources LLMs look to in your industry.
3. Nuanced reporting – analyzing how LLMs think about your company, and giving you extremely detailed reports on why they make the recommendations they do.

Unusual also track AI crawls of your content, so you can measure when it’s getting picked up and referenced by LLMs, helping you track ROI.

**Results:**

Quality wins fast with AI systems – content with rich and needed information is quickly picked up and referenced.

For [Parley](https://parley.so), an early customer, Unusual identified a key gap in what Perplexity knew about the space of SOC2 compliant AI for law firms. It automatically published pages to fill the gaps ([Model Use, Data Flows, and Isolation by Firm](https://ai.parley.so/model-use-data-flows-firm-isolation), [Encryption, Access Controls, and Audit Logging](https://ai.parley.so/encryption-access-controls-audit-logging)) and within a month, those two pages were within the top 3 most important citations for the topic area.

**Bezel turns days-long apparel photo and video shoots into studio-quality images and videos in seconds—with AI and a few clicks.** What once costed $5,000 a shoot and required a full production team can now be created for a fraction of the price, instantly.

**_Promo:_** All new signups this month get **10,000 free credits** on Bezel—enough to generate hundreds of stunning images for your brand.

# [https://youtu.be/PKG8REHmbNM\\](https://youtu.be/PKG8REHmbNM%5C*%5C*%5C%5C)

# **The Problem**

Apparel brands invest over $100k annually on photo and video shoots to produce marketing content. Yet, even after this significant spend, marketing teams often lack a sufficient variety of high-quality imagery and video to develop fresh, high-performing ads and creatives at scale.

Due to a constant need to remix visuals, teams quickly exhaust their original shoot assets, creating a bottleneck that limits growth and stifles ad performance.

This gap between content needs and available assets slows experimentation, increases acquisition costs.

# **Our Solution**

Bezel makes it easy for e-commerce teams (small and large) to create realistic, studio-quality images and videos of their apparel on AI-generated human avatars.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93362&key=user_uploads/717333/b7ddc2ed-00bb-4fd3-8a5b-da5e30443a38)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93362&key=user_uploads/717333/d868f009-c760-47c1-ab79-a1992b799112)

Just upload your clothing images and Bezel quickly produces the visuals you need for ads, websites, and social media. No photo shoots, complex AI prompts, or creative delays. Bezel gives you the ready-to-use assets to power your next campaign.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93362&key=user_uploads/717333/dd2765d8-23af-454f-a4f4-3ad91209ada1)

# **Key Features**

* **Preset Human Models:** Choose from a wide variety of realistic male and female AI models in multiple ethnicities.
* **Instant Studio Shoots:** Generate studio-quality, static images of any apparel in seconds—no photo shoots needed.
* **Effortless AI Video Shoots:** Instantly create photorealistic videos of your apparel on human avatars, perfect for ads and social channels.
* **No AI Prompting Required:** Just upload your clothing image and Bezel handles the rest, with no technical skills needed.
* **Flexible Formats:** Download assets in both vertical and horizontal aspect ratios for websites, ads, and social use.
* **Self-Serve Platform:** Designed for fast, easy content creation meaning no waiting for bulk processing or outside support.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93362&key=user_uploads/717333/c79768da-8bae-4fe8-9875-cb224f3ac365)

launches.title: Cuckoo: Real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support
launches.tagline: Cuckoo helps companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty talk to their global customers, even in the most technical discussions.
launches.body:
### **TLDR**

[**Cuckoo**](https://www.cuckoo.so) is a real-time AI translator for global sales, marketing, and support. Companies like Snowflake and PagerDuty use Cuckoo in Zoom and in-person meetings for even the most technical discussions. 

Here an example of us having a product, sales, and partner meeting with our W25 batchmates and one of our partners in Japan: [**https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0**](https://youtu.be/7fq7wr_S8p0)

— 

Hey everyone! We are [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) and [Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and we are building Cuckoo to help global teams talk to their customers worldwide. [Give it a try](https://www.cuckoo.so) in your next global meeting 🌏

### **Why?**

**Language barriers are a big challenge even for global companies.** We experienced this firsthand in Korea, where we hosted community meetups, inviting product leaders around the world.

On the one hand, many nuances and details can get lost between languages, especially during technical conversations. On the other hand, speakers often felt isolated, unable to follow Korean discussions, and missed valuable opportunities to network and promote their products.

### **Problem**

Take Matt, a Solutions Engineer at PagerDuty APJ, who engages weekly with customers in Korea and Japan. These conversations are complicated not just by language barriers but also by technical details—think complex troubleshooting scenarios.

### **Solution**

**Cuckoo provides real-time translation tailored for you and your customers.** It instantly learns technical details from your documents—pitch decks, meeting notes, API docs—and delivers context-aware translation in 20+ languages.

### **How it works**

Invite Cuckoo to your online meeting. For in-person conversations, you can capture audio directly from your laptop.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/829469eb-8895-44f0-b686-b2c45bb2f716)

Upload relevant documents (pitch decks, API docs, user manuals, etc.) to help Cuckoo understand the general context and key terms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/64f98ba9-db35-43ca-b791-45ca41cd442f)

As the conversation unfolds, your and your customer can view live translations in your preferred languages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87400&key=user_uploads/427995/cd8cd259-5e60-4bb2-bfd1-808ea19577bc)

### **How our customers use Cuckoo**

We—_our first customer_—use Cuckoo everyday to demo and collect user feedback. Here’s how other teams use Cuckoo. 

* Snowflake — Hosting global customers at their Customer Experience Centers


* PagerDuty — Troubleshooting with local cloud partners in Korea and Japan
* ClickHouse — Team sync between the APAC and HQ office
* dbt Labs — Webinars for APAC customers and partners
* Weights & Biases — Hosting Seoul and Tokyo meetups with HQ executives

Cuckoo is also used by enterprises beyond the tech industry, including healthcare (SNOMED), manufacturing (SeAH Steel), and retail (GS).

### **Asks**

Are you dealing with cross-regional operations? Do you work with international customers regularly, or are you planning to expand into new markets?

* **Try out Cuckoo** at [www.cuckoo.so](http://www.cuckoo.so) — your first conversation is on us!
* **Let’s chat!** — We can hop on a quick call—we’ll speak in Korean and Japanese so you can see how Cuckoo works with different languages.
* [**Schedule a meeting**](https://cal.com/cuckoohq/30min) — We’d love to learn more about your language challenges and how we can help. 
* **Email us** at [founders@cuckoo.so](https://mailto:founders@cuckoo.so) — Tell us how your first meeting went, and send any feedback or thoughts!

### **A bit about us**

[Gunwoo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gunwooterry/) and [Yong Hee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harryyongheelee/) first met in 2015 through a student club at KAIST, where we organized an annual international conference for undergraduate students. Since then, we have been talking about starting a company together.

**Traction:** 20+ Brands live. On average brands see a 5X increase in AI search revenue after 30 days.

**TL;DR:** [Wildcard ](https://wild-card.ai/)helps brands and retailers rank first across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Rufus/Alexa, and Walmart Sparky. We audit and action on how your brand, products, and collections show up across every AI search and shopping platform. Wildcard creates the roadmap, and our AI agents execute on it. We create the content AI looks for, including enriching the product catalog, new blogs, collection pages, outreach to publications, and even Reddit and YouTube content to close the gap. Operators can review, approve, and measure how actions tie back to revenue.

**Launch Video:** <https://youtu.be/dkdV-s-JztE>

**The Problem:** Shoppers are googling less and less. They want an experience where they can ask questions, like talking to an in-store rep. They're prompting about what to buy, the model names a few, people purchase those, and you're left relying on Meta's rising ad spend to acquire new customers or retain existing ones. Producing content for millions of SKUs is beyond human scale, and what we found is that millions in revenue was lost because of it. Below is what we learned after 7 months talking with brand owners.

**What We Learned:**

1. It's not about training the model. Everyone gets this wrong. When someone asks, the model runs a live search, reads what it finds, and picks. What decides it is boring and specific: a catalog structured so the model can trust it, and the right content on the sources it reads.
2. Existing tools were built for SaaS. They hand you a score and stop. That playbook breaks the moment you have 5,000 SKUs and variants. A brand and retailers unit of AEO is the catalog, not a homepage.

**The Solution:** Our solution is simple. First, we run a full audit of how you show up across AI search. Second, we build your roadmap. Lastly, we optimize your product catalog and create the content that gets you recommended. After 30 days, we tend to see a 5x increase in revenue.

**Our Ask:** Try a free trial of our tool [here](https://wild-card.ai/). And if you know any brands, retailers, or agencies, an intro would be great!: [kaushik@wild-card.ai](mailto:kaushik@wild-card.ai)  

**About Me:** Kaushik Mahorker (Founder & CEO). Previously, I was an Engineering Manager at Scale AI, where I led the GenAI Allocation team and built the ecommerce enrichment engine that structured 2.4M attributes across 400K SKUs, helping close $15M+ in retail and marketplace contracts.
